Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: White as a color: 白色的衣服 "white clothes". It is 白 plus 色 ("color"). To describe a noun with it, add 的: 白色的衣服.
Black and also "dark": 天黑了 "it has got dark". It is both an adjective (黑头发 "black hair") and the color itself. 黑板 "blackboard" is built on it.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tiān hēi le, wǒmen huí jiā ba.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Black as a color name, said as a noun: 我喜欢黑色. Before a noun, use 黑色的 or just 黑: 黑色的包, 黑头发. The same 色 builds all the color words in this list.
Red. Its sound part 工 (gōng) is only a rough guide to hóng, but the same 工 turns up in other characters you will meet, such as 空 (kōng). 红 also appears in 红茶 "black tea", literally "red tea".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ yǒu yī jiàn hóng yīfu.
What color do you like?: I have a red piece of clothing.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Red as a color name. Use it as a noun (我喜欢红色) or before a noun with 的 (红色的车). Without 色, 红 is the adjective: 红花 "red flower".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Hóngsè de chē shì wǒ de.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Yellow. The traditional 黃 has a different top from the simplified 黄. It is also a surname and part of the river name 黄河, the Yellow River.
What color do you like?: In autumn the leaves have all turned yellow.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Yellow as a color name, same pattern as the other colors: 黄色的花 "yellow flowers". Measure word 只 goes before the animal, 黄色的 goes before the noun it describes.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā yǒu yī zhī huángsè de māo.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Blue. 蓝天 is a "blue sky", the phrase for clear weather. It can describe things directly: 天很蓝.
What color do you like?: The sky is very blue today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Blue as a color name: 蓝色的鞋 "blue shoes". Like the other colors it works as a noun (我喜欢蓝色) or before a noun with 的.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi lánsè de xié.
What color do you like?: I want to buy blue shoes.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Green, read lǜ (often typed lv). 绿灯 is a "green light" and 绿茶 "green tea".
Green as a color name: 绿色的树 "green trees". It is also used for things that are environmentally friendly, as in 绿色食品 "green food".
Spring. The four seasons come in the order 春夏秋冬, each with 天 ("day, sky") after it. A season word is used like a time word, before the verb: 春天我去公园.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Chūntiān lái le, huā kāi le.
What color do you like?: Spring has come and the flowers are out.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Summer, one of 春夏秋冬. It is a time word, so it goes before the verb or at the start: 夏天很热.
Autumn. Seasons are named in order 春夏秋冬, and each can take 天. 秋天 is a time word and goes before the verb: 秋天去爬山 "go hiking in autumn".
What color do you like?: The weather is nice in autumn.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Winter. The last of 春夏秋冬. Used as a time word before the verb: 冬天下雪 "it snows in winter". 冬 is also the sound part of 疼 "to hurt".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Dōngtiān hěn lěng, yào duō chuān yīfu.
What color do you like?: Winter is cold, so wear more clothes.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Spring Festival, the Chinese or Lunar New Year, whose date follows the lunar calendar and falls in January or February. Said in a sentence it is a time word: 春节回家.
What color do you like?: At Spring Festival I want to go home.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Celebrate the New Year, a verb and its object: 过 ("to pass, to spend a time") plus 年. 过年好 is a greeting at New Year. 过年了 means "the New Year is here".
你喜欢什么颜色？: 过年的时候，我们吃饺子。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 過年的時候，我們吃餃子。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Guònián de shíhou, wǒmen chī jiǎozi.
What color do you like?: At New Year we eat dumplings.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Festival, holiday: 节 ("festival") plus 日 ("day"), a day of celebration. Examples are 春节 and 中秋节.
What color do you like?: Spring Festival is a Chinese festival.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Two main meanings: a "festival" (春节), and a "section, class period" used as a measure word: 一节课 "one class". The traditional 節 has the bamboo radical ⺮ on top.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jīntiān yǒu liǎng jié kè.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Snow. The 雨 ("rain") on top is the meaning part. The bottom 彐 is what is left of an older sound part, 彗, so it no longer hints at the sound.
Snow, a verb and its object: 下 ("fall") plus 雪. Weather uses 下: 下雨 "rain", 下雪 "snow". 了 shows it has started. 下大雪 is "snow heavily".
Cloud. The traditional 雲 puts 雨 ("rain") on top of 云. 云 was the original character and 雨 was added later to make it clearer.
What color do you like?: There are many clouds in the sky.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Cloudy, from 多 ("many") plus 云 ("cloud"). A weather forecast word, in the same group as 晴 "clear" and 阴 "overcast": 明天多云.
What color do you like?: Tomorrow will be cloudy, with no rain.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Overcast, cloudy as a weather word: 天阴了. It is also the 阴 of 阴阳 yin and yang.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tiān yīn le, kěnéng yào xià yǔ.
What color do you like?: It has turned overcast, and it may rain.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Overcast day. 天 here means "weather, the day". Its opposite is 晴天. Say 今天是阴天 for "today is overcast", or simply 今天阴天.
Clear, fine of the sky: 天晴了 "the sky has cleared". Said of weather, not of people. 日 ("sun") is the meaning part, and the sound part 青 (qīng) is close to qíng.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Yǔ tíng le, tiān qíng le.
What color do you like?: The rain stopped and the sky cleared.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Sunny day, fine weather. It is the opposite of 阴天. 晴 and 天 together: 晴天 "clear day". 明天是晴天 is a typical forecast.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 明天是晴天，我们去爬山。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 明天是晴天，我們去爬山。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Míngtiān shì qíngtiān, wǒmen qù páshān.
What color do you like?: Tomorrow will be sunny, so let's go hiking.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Cool, at a pleasant or mildly cold level. The simplified 凉 has 冫 (ice) on the left, while the traditional 涼 has 氵 (water). Both have 京 as sound part.
What color do you like?: It is a bit cool in the evening.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Pleasantly cool, good in hot weather: 这里很凉快. It is a pleasant coolness, unlike 冷 "cold". The 快 is light: liángkuai. It can also be a verb: 凉快一下 "cool off a bit".
What color do you like?: It is nice and cool here.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Below zero: 零下五度 "minus five degrees". 零 is "zero" and 下 is "below". The opposite is 零上 "above zero". Put the number between 零下 and 度.
What color do you like?: Today it is five below zero.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Air temperature, the weather-forecast word: 气 ("air") plus 温 ("warm"). Said of the air outside: 今天气温很高. For the temperature of other things, such as water, use 温度.
What color do you like?: The air temperature is high today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Temperature, for anything: the air, water or a room. 水的温度. Compared with 气温, which is only for the air outside. It goes with 高 and 低: 温度很高.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Shuǐ de wēndù tài gāo le.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Sun: 太 ("very great") plus 阳. Also the sun's light: 晒太阳 "sunbathe". The 阳 is light: tàiyang. 阳 is a simplified form of 陽, and 阴阳 pairs it with 阴.
What color do you like?: The sun comes up from the east.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Moon: 月 ("moon, month") plus 亮 ("bright"). The 亮 is light: yuèliang. 月 alone can mean "month" as well as "moon", so 月亮 is the clear word for the moon itself.
Stars, a doubled word whose second syllable is light: xīngxing. A single star can be 星 in compounds such as 星期, but 星星 is the word on its own. Measure word 颗: 一颗星星.
What color do you like?: You can see the stars at night.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: In the sky: 天 ("sky") plus 上 ("on, above"). Place words with 上 say where something is: 桌子上, 天上. Here 上 is read shàng in full.
What color do you like?: There is a bird in the sky.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Air: 空 ("empty, sky") plus 气 ("air"). It goes with 好 and 新鲜 ("fresh"): 空气很好. Take care with 空: kōng here, but kòng in 有空 "have free time".
What color do you like?: The air is very good here.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Air, gas and "breath". It is also in 天气 "weather", 生气 "get angry" and 空气. The traditional 氣 puts 米 ("rice") inside 气, and the simplified form keeps only the older 气.
The Earth, the planet: 地 ("earth") plus 球 ("ball, sphere"). 球 appears in every ball: 足球, 篮球. Say 地球上 for "on Earth".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒmen dōu zhù zài dìqiú shang.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Nature, the natural world: 大 ("big") plus 自然 ("natural"). Used in phrases like 亲近大自然 "get close to nature" and 走进大自然. Do not say it for human nature.
Sea. On its own it is common in compounds: 海边, 大海, 上海. 氵 ("water") is on the left. Place names such as 上海 "Shanghai" use it, meaning "on the sea".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jiā lí hǎi hěn jìn.
What color do you like?: My home is close to the sea.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Seaside, by the sea: 海 ("sea") plus 边 ("side"). 去海边 "go to the sea". The traditional 邊 has a complicated right side that the simplified 边 shortens to 力.
The sea, the ocean: 大 ("big") plus 海. Like 海, it is the sea as a place, but it suits describing it as vast or open: 大海很蓝, 看大海.
River. 氵 ("water") is on the left, and 可 is a rough sound part (kě, hé). In names: 黄河 the Yellow River. 河边 "river bank".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Hé lǐ yǒu hěn duō yú.
What color do you like?: There are many fish in the river.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Lake. 氵 ("water") with 胡 as sound part, which sounds exactly the same, hú. In names such as 西湖 West Lake. 湖边 "lakeside" is a typical phrase.
What color do you like?: There are many people by the lake.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Grass. The 艹 on top marks plants and 早 ("early") is the sound part: cǎo and zǎo differ only in the first sound. In 草地 "lawn", and 吃草 "eat grass" is what cows and horses do.
Grass land, lawn, meadow: 草 ("grass") plus 地 ("ground"). Say 在草地上 "on the grass". The 地 is read dì in the word, not the particle de.
What color do you like?: The children are playing on the grass.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bird. Measure word 只: 一只鸟. It began as a picture of a bird with a dangling tail; the traditional form is 鳥, and the simplified 鸟 follows its handwritten shape.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Shù shang yǒu liǎng zhī niǎo.
What color do you like?: There are two birds in the tree.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Fish, both the animal and the food. Measure word 条: 一条鱼. 我不吃鱼 means "I don't eat fish", and the same word is used on a menu.
Cat. Measure word 只: 一只猫. In the traditional 貓 the left side is 豸 rather than 犭. The sound part 苗 (miáo) is a rough guide to māo.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jiā yǒu yī zhī māo.
What color do you like?: We have a cat at home.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Dog. Measure word 只 (or 条): 一只狗. 犭 on the left marks animals. 小狗 is "puppy". 狗 is the same in both scripts.
Chicken, the animal, and 鸡肉 is the meat. The traditional 雞 has 隹 (a short-tailed bird) on the right. The simplified 鸡 replaces the old sound part 奚 with 又, so 又 does not give the sound.
Animal: 动 ("move") plus 物 ("thing"), so a "moving thing". Used for animals in general: 你喜欢什么动物？ Compare 植物 "plant".
Zoo: 动物 ("animal") plus 园 ("garden, park"). 园 turns up in 公园, 花园 and 幼儿园. 去动物园 "go to the zoo".
What color do you like?: We go to the zoo on Saturday.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Garden, a place with flowers: 花 ("flower") plus 园. Compare 院子 for a courtyard or yard that belongs to a house. 花园里 "in the garden".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Huāyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō huā.
What color do you like?: There are many flowers in the garden.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Park, a public place: 公 ("public") plus 园. 去公园 "go to the park". 公 also appears in 公共 "public" and 公司 "company".
What color do you like?: I walk in the park every day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Courtyard, yard, the open area around or inside a house. 子 is light here: yuànzi. A house with 院子 has its own ground. In 医院 "hospital" and 电影院 "cinema" 院 means a larger building.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jiā yǒu yī ge xiǎo yuànzi.
What color do you like?: Our home has a small yard.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Crawl, climb with hands and feet: a baby crawls, and people climb a mountain or stairs. 爬山 is "hike up a mountain", 爬楼 "climb stairs". 巴 (bā) is the sound part.
What color do you like?: The child is crawling on the floor.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Climb a mountain, go hiking, a verb and its object: 爬 ("climb") plus 山 ("mountain"). It is the usual word for a hill walk. 周末去爬山 "go hiking at the weekend".
What color do you like?: We go hiking at the weekend.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Head: 头疼 "headache", 点头 "nod". The traditional 頭 has 頁 ("head") as the meaning part and 豆 as the sound part; the simplified 头 comes from handwriting. 头 is also the measure word for cattle: 一头牛.
Hair on the head, with 头 ("head") plus 发. Hair is not counted: 头发很长. The simplified 发 stands for both 髮 "hair" and 發 "send out", so in traditional characters this word is 頭髮. The 发 is light: tóufa.
Face: 洗脸 "wash your face". 脸 is also face in the sense of dignity or embarrassment: 丢脸 "lose face". The left side ⺼ (flesh) marks body parts, as in 腿 and 脚.
Eye in compounds and in 看一眼 "take a look": 眼 works as a measure word for a glance. For the eye as a part of the body, the full word is 眼睛. 目 ("eye") is the meaning part on the left.
Eye, eyes: 眼 plus 睛. The 睛 is hardly used outside this word. Its sound part 青 is the same as in 晴 "clear (weather)". For a pair of eyes the measure word is 双: 一双眼睛. The 睛 is light: yǎnjing.
Mouth: the body part, as in 张开嘴 "open your mouth". For openings and entrances 口 is used instead, as in 门口 "doorway". 口 is also the meaning part of 嘴, on the left.
Leg. Its sound part 退 (tuì) is almost the same as tuǐ. The left side ⺼ (flesh) marks body parts. 腿 covers the whole leg, while 脚 is the foot.
Foot: 脚 is below the ankle and 腿 is the leg. In traditional characters it is written 腳, with 卻 in place of 却. Compounds include 脚步 "footstep".
The whole body: 全 ("whole") plus 身 ("body"). 全 is put before a noun to mean "all of": 全家 "the whole family", 全校 "the whole school". 全身都 means "all over the body".
Height, build: 个子高 "tall", 个子矮 "short". It describes how big a person is. Said as gèzi with a light 子.
Nod: 点 ("point") plus 头. It is used for agreeing or greeting. 点点头 repeats the verb for a small action.
Raise a hand, as when answering in class: a verb and its object, 举 ("lift") plus 手. A teacher says 请举手 or 有问题请举手.
What color do you like?: If you have a question, please raise your hand.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Dirty: 手很脏 "the hands are dirty". It is read zāng. The opposite is 干净 "clean". In traditional characters it is 髒, which has 骨 ("bone") in it.
Take a bath or shower: 洗 ("wash") plus 澡, a verb and its object, so it splits like 洗了澡 or 洗个澡. The 澡 is not used on its own. 洗脸 "wash the face" works the same way.
What color do you like?: I take a shower every evening.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Full after eating, not "full" of space: 吃饱了 "I have eaten my fill", which you say to turn down more food. The opposite is 饿 "hungry". The traditional form is 飽, and the sound part 包 is read bāo.
To hurt, to ache: 头疼, 肚子疼 "stomach ache". Also "to love dearly": 妈妈很疼她. The sound part 冬 (dōng) sounds only a little like téng. 疒 on the outside is the sickness radical.
Comfortable: 这张床很舒服. Also "well, in good health": 我不舒服 "I don't feel well". 服 is light: shūfu. Its opposite is 不舒服.
What color do you like?: I don't feel very well today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Blow: 风吹来了 "the wind blows in". People blow with their mouths, and 口 is the meaning part on the left. The thing blown goes before it: 风吹, or after it: 吹气 "blow air".
Pull: the opposite of 推, written on doors as 拉 "pull". 拉 also means to play a bowed instrument: 拉小提琴. 扌 (hand) is the meaning part for 拉, 推 and other hand actions.
Push: the opposite of 拉. Door signs say 推 and 拉. With 开 it means "push open": 推开门. Like 拉, it has 扌 (hand) on the left. It also means "recommend" in 推荐.
Breakfast: 早 ("early") plus 餐 ("meal"). The three meals are 早餐, 午餐 and 晚餐. In everyday talk 早饭 is also said. The word is a little more formal, as on a hotel sign.
Lunch: 午 ("noon") plus 餐. 午 is also in 中午 and 下午. The matching words are 早餐 and 晚餐. Like them it suits menus and writing, and in speech 午饭 is common.
Dinner, supper: 晚 ("late, evening") plus 餐. With 早餐 and 午餐 it makes the three meals. 晚饭 is the more spoken form.
What color do you like?: What do you want for dinner?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Chinese food, the opposite of 西餐. 中 means "Chinese" here, as in 中国 and 中文. 我们去吃中餐 "let's go eat Chinese food". 中餐 can also be heard as "a midday meal".
Western food: 西 ("west") plus 餐. It covers steak, pasta and the like, and is the opposite of 中餐. 西餐厅 is a Western-style restaurant. 吃西餐 "eat Western food".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ xiǎng chī zhōngcān háishi xīcān?
What color do you like?: Do you want Chinese or Western food?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Fast food: 快 ("fast") plus 餐. 快餐店 is a fast-food restaurant. The word is not about the speed of eating but about a type of meal that is served quickly.
What color do you like?: I don't often eat fast food.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Food in general: 食 ("eat") plus 物 ("thing"). It names foods as items, not meals or dishes. It is more formal than 吃的. It is not counted with 个; use 种 for kinds: 这种食物.
What color do you like?: This kind of food is delicious.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Dumplings, the filled kind, often boiled. 包饺子 "make dumplings" uses 包 ("wrap"). The 子 is light: jiǎozi. In traditional characters it is 餃子, with the food radical 飠 on the left.
Instant noodles: 方便 ("convenient") plus 面 ("noodles"). Traditional 麵 has 麥 ("wheat") in it, while 面 alone means "face" or "surface". That is why the traditional word is 方便麵.
What color do you like?: I had instant noodles for dinner.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Egg: 鸡蛋 "chicken egg", 蛋糕 "cake" ("egg cake"). 蛋 is mostly used in compounds, with 鸡蛋 being the everyday word for a hen's egg. Counting: 一个蛋, 两个鸡蛋.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ zǎoshang chī le liǎng ge dàn.
What color do you like?: I had two eggs this morning.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Uncooked rice, and also "meter". The rice you eat cooked is 米饭. For heights and lengths: 一米八 "1.8 meters" is a typical way to say a height. 米 is a picture of rice grains.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jiā mǎi le hěn duō mǐ.
What color do you like?: My family bought a lot of rice.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Oil, fat: cooking oil, and also "oily, greasy": 太油了 "too greasy". 油 appears in 汽油 "gasoline" and in 加油, "add oil", a call to cheer someone on. 氵 (water) is the meaning part.
Alcohol, liquor: 喝酒 "drink alcohol", 白酒, 啤酒. The 酉 on the right was itself the older character for this word, and 氵 (water) was added later to make it clearer.
Taste, flavor: 这个菜味道很好. It is also used for smell: 有一股味道. 口 (mouth) is in 味. The 道 is light: wèidao. Compare 好吃, which says only that something is tasty.

Three uses: food is "cooked" (饭熟了), fruit is "ripe", and people are "familiar": 我和他不熟 "I don't know him well". 熟人 means "acquaintance". 灬 (fire) is at the bottom. Heard as shú, and in some speech as shóu.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ hé tā bù tài shú.
What color do you like?: I don't know him very well.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Menu: 菜 ("dish") plus 单 ("list"). In a restaurant, ask 请给我菜单. 单 also appears in 名单 "name list" and 单 "single".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Qǐng gěi wǒ kàn yīxià càidān.
What color do you like?: Please let me see the menu.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Restaurant: 饭 ("food") plus 馆, a place that offers a service. A plain sit-down place to eat. 餐馆 means about the same. Counted with 家: 一家饭馆.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè jiā fànguǎn de cài hěn hǎochī.
What color do you like?: The food in this restaurant is delicious.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Takeout, food delivery: 外 ("outside") plus 卖 ("sell"), so food sold to be eaten outside. 点外卖 "order delivery" uses 点, which also means "order" when you pick dishes.
Cook a meal: a verb and its object, 做 ("make") plus 饭 ("meal"). It can split: 做了饭, 做好饭. 做饭 is for the whole task of preparing a meal, while a single dish is 做菜.
Cheers!, literally "dry the cup". 干 here is gān, "dry, empty". The traditional word is 乾杯 and uses 乾 for "dry", which the simplified 干 also stands for. People say it when they raise their glasses.
Chopsticks. Its sound part 快 is read the same, kuài, and 竹 ("bamboo", ⺮) on top gives the material. The measure word is 双 ("pair"): 一双筷子. Use 用 for using them: 用筷子. The 子 is light: kuàizi.
Bowl, and also the measure word for a bowlful: 一碗米饭, 一碗面. Its sound part 宛 is read wǎn, the same as the word. 石 (stone) on the left is the meaning part.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ chī le liǎng wǎn fàn.
What color do you like?: I ate two bowls of rice.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bottle, and the measure word for what is in it: 一瓶水 "a bottle of water". For the object itself the word is usually 瓶子. The sound part 并 is read bìng, so it hints only a little at píng.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng yào yī píng shuǐ.
What color do you like?: I would like a bottle of water.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bottle, the object. 瓶 is the measure word (一瓶水), while 瓶子 is the thing itself, a noun. The 子 is light: píngzi.
What color do you like?: There is water in the bottle.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Smell, as a verb: 闻一闻 "have a sniff", 闻到 "smell (something)". The traditional 聞 holds 耳 ("ear") inside 門, though the everyday meaning today is smell, not hearing. 闻 does mean "hear" in older words such as 新闻 "news".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ wéndào le fàn de wèidao.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Happy, in a good mood: 开 ("open") plus 心 ("heart"), an open heart. It is close to 高兴 from level 1, and both are everyday words. The opposite is 不开心. 玩得开心 is a way to say "have a good time".
Happy, joyful, used a lot in greetings: 生日快乐 "happy birthday", 新年快乐 "happy New Year". Here 乐 is read lè. In 音乐 "music" the same character is read yuè.

Cute, lovable: 可 ("can") plus 爱 ("love"), literally "can be loved". Said of children, animals and things. The traditional 愛 has 心 ("heart") in the middle; the simplified 爱 has 友 ("friend") in its place.
Scary, frightening: 可 plus 怕, literally "worth fearing". 可 before a verb gives an adjective in this way, as in 可爱. It says something is scary: 可怕的电影, whereas 怕 says you are afraid.
Be afraid of: 我怕狗 "I'm afraid of dogs". It also means "I'm afraid that…": 我怕他不来. 忄 (heart) is the meaning part on the left. 白 only roughly gives the sound (bái and pà).
What color do you like?: I am afraid of the dark.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: In a hurry, anxious, impatient: 别急 "don't worry, take your time". It describes a feeling of pressure, as when waiting or running late: 我很急. 着急 is a close relative, and both are common.
Cry: 别哭 "don't cry". It is for tears and sobbing, not for shouting. Its oldest forms show a person with a loud mouth, and the lower 犬 in today's shape does not mean "dog".
Satisfied, pleased with: the thing you are satisfied with follows 对: 对这里很满意 "very satisfied with this place". 满 means "full", so the idea is that your wishes have been filled.
Dissatisfied: 对…不满, as in 他对工作不满. Before a number, 不满 means "less than, not yet reaching": 不满十岁 "under ten years old".
What color do you like?: He is not yet ten years old.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Moved, touched, a feeling you have: 我很感动. It is also a verb for what moves you: 他的话感动了我. 感 ("feel") plus 动 ("move"), so a heart that has been moved.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tīng le tā de huà, wǒ hěn gǎndòng.
What color do you like?: After hearing his words, I was very moved.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Feel, become aware of, a little more formal than 觉得. What you feel follows directly: 感到高兴, 感到很累. It reports a state you notice in yourself.
Both a noun, "a feeling, an impression", and a verb, "to feel": 我感觉有点冷. 觉 is read jué here, but jiào in 睡觉. Similar to 觉得, but 感觉 is also used as a noun: 感觉很好 "a good feeling".
Mood: 心情好 "in a good mood", 心情不好 "in a bad mood". It is what is in your heart (心) at a given time. 情 has 青 as sound part, as in 请 and 晴.
What color do you like?: She is in a very good mood today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: In the heart, in one's mind: 心里想 "think to oneself", 心里很高兴 "happy inside". The traditional form is 心裡, where 衤 (clothes) is added to 里. Said xīnli, with a light 里.
In the heart, a more written way to say 心里. It sits in expressions such as 心中的想法 "the thoughts in one's heart". 中 here means "within", not "middle".
Rest at ease, not worry: 放 ("put down") plus 心 ("heart"), so putting your heart down. 请放心 and 你放心 reassure someone. 放心不下 is the opposite, "cannot stop worrying".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ fàngxīn, wǒ bù huì wàng.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Careful, watch out: 小心！ is a warning, and 小心 + verb gives advice: 小心路滑 "watch for the slippery road". 路上小心 is said to someone setting off. Literally "small heart".
Sad, upset, a feeling: 我很难过. With 难 read nán, it also exists as "hard to get through". 难受 is close, but covers physical discomfort too.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tīngshuō tā zǒu le, wǒ hěn nánguò.
What color do you like?: I heard he left, and I'm sad.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Feel awful, uncomfortable, of the body or of the feelings: 我头很难受, 心里难受. It is broader than 难过, which is only sad. 难 ("hard") plus 受 ("bear"): hard to bear.
Ugly, unsightly, the opposite of 好看. 难 in front of a verb makes "hard to V", and here the meaning is "unpleasant to look at". It also describes an awkward moment or a bad look on a face.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè jiàn yīfu tài nánkàn le.
What color do you like?: This piece of clothing is so ugly.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Unpleasant to hear, of a sound, a song or words. The opposite is 好听. The pattern 难 + verb is the same as in 难看: it says a thing is not pleasant to do.
Be willing to: 愿意 + verb, as in 你愿意来吗？ It states a wish that comes from the person, unlike 要, which can be a need. The traditional 願 has 頁 ("head") on the right, and the 原 gives the sound.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ yuànyì hé wǒ qù ma?
What color do you like?: Are you willing to go with me?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Confidence: 有信心 "be confident". The person or thing you are confident about follows 对: 对自己有信心 "have confidence in oneself". 信 ("trust") plus 心 ("heart").
Care about, be concerned for: 关心 + person, as in 关心他. 谢谢你的关心 is the usual thanks for a kind word. It is about caring in the heart, not about taking care of a thing.
Thank, a more formal word than 谢谢. It takes the person or the help directly: 感谢你的帮助, 感谢大家. It is used in speeches and writing, and in everyday talk 谢谢 is enough.
Welcome: 欢迎你 "welcome, you". The shop greeting is 欢迎光临. It is also a verb: 欢迎你来我家 "you are welcome to come to my home".
What color do you like?: You are welcome at my home.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Sorry, excuse me, a light apology, or a way to start a request: 不好意思，请问… The same words also say "I feel embarrassed": 我不好意思. It is mild, and for a real wrong use 对不起.
Treat someone, pay for the meal: a verb and its object, 请 ("invite") plus 客 ("guest"). 我请客 means "my treat". The guest is the one who is invited.
Request, ask for: more formal than 请. 请求 + person + verb: 他请求我帮忙. It is also a noun, "a request": 同意他的请求.
Beg, ask for earnestly: 求你了 "please, I'm begging you". 求 + person + verb: 求你帮我一下. It is stronger than 请, and also means "seek": 求学 "study".
Agree, promise: 答应 + verb, as in 他答应来. It also means "answer, reply" to a call: 答应一声. 答 is read dā here, and 应 is light: dāying.
Hello? or "Hey!", used to answer the phone or to call to someone: 喂，你好. It is read wèi in the fourth tone. 口 (mouth) is the meaning part, as in other calling and speaking sounds.
A sentence-ending particle that warms up a sentence: 好啊 "sure!", 你好啊. The tone is light a5, and after a vowel sound it blends into ya and is often written 呀. It does not carry meaning on its own.
What color do you like?: The weather is really nice today!

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Friendly, of people, a country or an attitude: 友好 ("friend" plus "good"). 友 is the same as in 朋友. 这里的人很友好 is a typical compliment.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhèlǐ de rén dōu hěn yǒuhǎo.
What color do you like?: The people here are all friendly.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Warm, enthusiastic, of a person who welcomes you: 热 ("hot") plus 情 ("feeling"). 他很热情 "he is very warm". With 地 it turns into an adverb: 热情地欢迎.
What color do you like?: The teacher is very warm to us.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Good night, said when someone goes to bed or you part late. Not "good evening", which is 晚上好. 晚 ("late") plus 安 ("peaceful"). A typical pair is 晚安，明天见.
Literally "add oil", a cheer: "Go for it!" "Come on!" It is shouted at sports, or said to someone who has a hard task. It also means "fill up with gas".
What color do you like?: Come on, you can do it!

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: A fixed wish to someone who sets off: "have a safe trip". 一路 ("the whole way") plus 平安 ("safe and sound"). Say it as 祝你一路平安.
A fixed wish to someone who is leaving: "bon voyage". Literally "may the wind be smooth the whole way": 一路 plus 顺风 ("with a following wind"). Often paired with 一路平安.
Early morning: 早 ("early") plus 晨 ("morning"). It sounds a little more written than 早上, and it is the stretch just after sunrise: 早晨的空气 "the morning air". 晨 hardly occurs on its own.
Midnight, the middle of the night: 半 ("half") plus 夜 ("night"). Give the hour after it: 半夜两点. It means the deep of the night, not just "late". Often followed by 才 or 还 to show how late.
What color do you like?: He didn't come home until midnight.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Night: 夜里 and 半夜 use it. Alone it feels more written than 晚上 and appears in set phrases and compounds: 夜深了 "the night is late". Compare 晚上 "evening", the common spoken word.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Yè shēn le, kuài shuì ba.
What color do you like?: It's late at night, go to sleep.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: At night: 夜 ("night") plus 里 ("inside"). Used like 晚上, it is a time word and goes before the verb. 里 is light: yèli.
Nap after lunch: 午 ("noon") plus 睡 ("sleep"). The phrase 睡午觉 means the same, with 觉 read jiào. Both the habit and the act: 我每天午睡 "I nap every day".
What color do you like?: I take a nap every day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Evening party, evening show: 晚 ("evening") plus 会 ("gathering"). The famous 春节晚会 is a New Year's Eve television show. Here 会 means "gathering", not "can".
What color do you like?: There is a party this evening.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Week, as a measure: 一周, 三周 "three weeks". Also a surname, and the name of an old dynasty. In traditional characters the "week" meaning is written 週, which has 辶 added, while 周 stays for the surname.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xué le sān zhōu Hànyǔ.
What color do you like?: I have studied Chinese for three weeks.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Weekend: 周 ("week") plus 末 ("end"). 周末 is a time word, put before the verb: 周末我去爬山.
What color do you like?: Are you free at the weekend?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Last week: 上 ("above, previous") plus 周. 上周三 is "last Wednesday". The matching word for next week is 下周. As a time word it goes before the verb, or at the start of the sentence.
What color do you like?: Last week I went to Beijing.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Next week: 下 ("below, next") plus 周. 下周一 is "next Monday". Time words go before the verb.
What color do you like?: We have an exam next week.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Month, as a named month of the year: 三月份 "the month of March", 哪个月份 "which month". For a length of time use 个月: 三个月. 份 is read fèn here, with 分 as the sound part.
What color do you like?: In which month are you coming?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Day, days and "life": 日子 is a particular day (好日子 "a good day") and the days of one's life: 日子过得很好 "life is going well". The 子 is light: rìzi. 天 is used to count days.
The year before last: 前 ("before") plus 年. It follows 今年 and 去年, going back in the same pattern. It is used as a time word before the verb. 前天 "the day before yesterday" works the same way.
What color do you like?: I went to Beijing the year before last.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: The whole year: 全 ("whole") plus 年. Often with 都: 全年都很热 "hot all year". 全年 has the same pattern as 全家 and 全身.
What color do you like?: It is hot here all year.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Minute as a length of time: 十分钟 "ten minutes". For the minute on the clock, 分 is used alone: 三点十分. Do not put 个 before 分钟. The traditional form is 分鐘, with 鐘 for "clock".
Holiday period, vacation: 假 ("leave") plus 期 ("period"). 假 is read jià here, but jiǎ in 假 "fake". 放假 is "to be on vacation". 暑假 is the summer vacation.
What color do you like?: Where do you want to go in the holidays?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Take leave, be on vacation, a verb and its object: 休 ("rest") plus 假 ("leave"). 休假 is time off that someone takes, while 放假 is a holiday given to everyone, such as a school break. The 休 shows a person leaning against a tree, resting.
What color do you like?: I am on leave next week.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: The school term begins: 开 ("open") plus 学 ("school"), a verb and its object. 开学了 says classes have started again. 开学第一天 is "the first day of term".
School term, semester: 上学期 "last term", 这学期 "this term", 下学期 "next term". 学 ("study") plus 期 ("period"). A term is not a school year; that is学年.
What color do you like?: I am very busy this term.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: When I was little (or "when one was little"): 小 plus 时候 ("time"). The phrase usually stands at the start of the sentence and sets the time. The light 候 gives xiǎoshíhou.
What color do you like?: When I was little, I lived in Beijing.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: From childhood: 从 ("from") plus 小 ("small, young"). It sits before the verb and is often followed by 就: 从小就学汉语 "has learned Chinese since childhood".
What color do you like?: He has studied Chinese since he was little.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Have free time, with the spoken ending 儿 that makes kòngr. 有空 means the same thing. Asking it invites someone: 你明天有空儿吗？ 空 is read kòng here, but kōng in 空气.
Anniversary: the number goes before it, as in 十周年 "tenth anniversary". It is also used for institutions and schools.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè jiā diàn shí zhōunián le.
What color do you like?: This shop has reached its tenth anniversary.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Adult, grown-up, as against 小孩. 大 ("big") plus 人. It is used for age, not for size. It is said as dàren with a light 人. 大人 and 小孩 can be used together as "adults and children".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè bù diànyǐng dàren yě xǐhuan.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Good person: 好 plus 人. 他是个好人 says he is a kind, decent person. It is the opposite of 坏人. It is a noun, with no 的 between 好 and 人.
Bad person, villain in stories and films: 坏 ("bad") plus 人. 坏 also means "broken": 手机坏了. The traditional 壞 has a much longer right side, which the simplified 坏 replaces with 不.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 电影里有好人，也有坏人。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 電影裡有好人，也有壞人。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Diànyǐng lǐ yǒu hǎorén, yě yǒu huàirén.
What color do you like?: In the film there are good people and bad people.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Guest, visitor: 来客人了 "guests have come". Its opposite is 主人, the host. 客 has 宀 (roof) on top, and the 各 below gives the sound. 客人 is also a customer in a shop or restaurant.
What color do you like?: Guests have come to our home.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Host, owner, as against 客人. The owner of a house, or a pet: 小狗的主人. 主 on its own means "main, chief", as in 主要. 主人 is the one who receives guests.
What color do you like?: The puppy is waiting for its owner.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Pedestrian, passer-by: 行 here is read xíng and means "walk, go", and 人 is "person". It is the word used on signs, like 行人请走人行道. In 银行 the same 行 is read háng.
What color do you like?: There are no pedestrians on the road.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Someone, there is someone: 有人 + verb: 有人在敲门 "someone is knocking". As a question, 有人吗？ asks "is anyone there?" The opposite is 没有人, "nobody". The noun is not marked with 一个.
What color do you like?: Someone is waiting for you outside.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: People in general, as a group: 人们都喜欢 "people all like". It is not used with a number: say 三个人, not 三个人们. 们 is the plural ending of 我们 and 他们.
Everyone, all of us: 大家好 is how you greet a group. 大家 can include the speaker, and it is followed by 都 when the group does something together: 大家都来了.
We, including the person you speak to: "you and I". It is a spoken word, and it is mostly met as 咱们. Pair it with a suggestion: 咱走吧 "let's go". Compare 我们, which may leave the listener out.
We including the listener: 咱们一起去吧 "let's go together". 我们 may or may not include the person you talk to, but 咱们 always does. It is a spoken word.

It, for things and animals but not people: 我喜欢它 "I like it". The subject is often left out in Chinese, so 它 appears mostly where the thing needs to be named again. In traditional writing 牠 is also used for an animal.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè běn shū hěn hǎo, wǒ xǐhuan tā.
What color do you like?: This book is good, I like it.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: They or "them", for things and animals, never for people: 我喜欢它们. The plural ending 们 is added to 它. People are 他们 and 她们. In traditional writing animals may be written 牠們.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 这些书很好，我都喜欢它们。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 這些書很好，我都喜歡它們。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhèxiē shū hěn hǎo, wǒ dōu xǐhuan tāmen.
What color do you like?: These books are good, I like them all.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Oneself, repeated for emphasis: 我自己 "myself", 自己做 "do it oneself". It follows the person: 他自己, 你自己. Take care with the shape of 己: it is open at the top, 已 (yǐ, in 已经) is half closed and 巳 is closed.
Wife or "Mrs", a married woman. 他太太 is "his wife", and 王太太 is "Mrs Wang". The second 太 is light: tàitai. When a man speaks of his own wife he can say 我太太. It is for a married woman, not a girlfriend.

Spouse (husband or wife) in 我爱人 "my husband/wife", said of the person you are married to; a rather formal way to refer to them. 爱 ("love") plus 人. It does not mean "lover": that is 情人, which in everyday speech usually means a partner in an affair.
What color do you like?: My spouse works at a bank.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Romantic love, between lovers: 爱 ("love") plus 情 ("feeling"). It is not used for love of family, which is 亲情, or of friends. 爱情故事 is "a love story".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shì yī ge àiqíng gùshi.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Family, household as a unit: 家庭 is more formal than 家. It goes with 成员 "member" and with 幸福 "happy": 家庭成员 "family member". 庭 on its own means "yard".
Parent, guardian of a student: 家长会 is a parents' meeting at school. 长 is read zhǎng.
What color do you like?: The teacher asks the parents to come to school.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: The whole family: 全 ("whole") plus 家. Often 全家人, with 人. With 都 it means all of them: 全家都在北京 "the whole family is in Beijing". The same pattern as 全身 and 全年.
What color do you like?: The whole family is in Beijing.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Make friends: 交 ("hand over, associate with") plus 朋友, a verb and its object. 交朋友 means to form a friendship, and 交了一个朋友 "made a friend". 交 appears in 交通 and 交流 too.
What color do you like?: I want to make friends here.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Old friend: 老 here means "long-standing", not "aged". The old friend is one you have known a long time. 老 is also a friendly prefix in 老师. The light ending gives lǎopéngyou.
What color do you like?: He is an old friend of mine.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Colleague, co-worker: 同 ("same") plus 事 ("work, matter"), someone who shares the same work. Compare 同学, "classmate". 事 on its own means "matter, thing". The two words are 同事 and 同学.
Surname, and as a verb "be surnamed": 你姓什么？ asks for the surname only. The surname goes after 姓: 我姓王. To give a full name, use 叫: 我叫王明.
Full name, in a formal setting such as a form: 请写你的姓名. 姓 ("surname") plus 名 ("given name"). In everyday speech 名字 is the word. 姓名 appears on documents and name tags.
Because. 因为 starts the reason clause, and 所以 often starts the result clause: 因为下雨，所以我没去. Chinese can use both, though English uses only one.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Yīnwèi xià yǔ, wǒ méi qù.
What color do you like?: Because it rained, I didn't go.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: So, therefore: it opens the result clause. It often follows 因为: 因为…，所以… . It can be used without 因为: 我累了，所以想睡觉.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ lèi le, suǒyǐ xiǎng shuìjiào.
What color do you like?: I'm tired, so I want to sleep.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: But, the shortest of the group: 但 starts the second clause, which goes against the first. 但是 is the usual form, and 但 is somewhat more written.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng qù, dàn méiyǒu shíjiān.
What color do you like?: I want to go, but I have no time.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: But, however, the standard word. It starts the second clause: 这个很好，但是太贵了. It pairs with 虽然: 虽然…，但是… . 可是 and 不过 do the same job, in a more spoken way.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhège hěn hǎo, dànshì tài guì le.
What color do you like?: This one is good, but too expensive.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: But, the same job as 但是 and a more spoken one. It starts a clause that goes against the one before: 他很累，可是还想工作. 可 on its own is not "but".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā hěn lèi, kěshì hái xiǎng gōngzuò.
What color do you like?: He is tired, but he still wants to work.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: But, however, softer than 但是: it adds a note that limits what was said before. 菜很好吃，不过有点贵. Spoken more than written. Dictionaries write the tone of 不 as bù here, though people say bú before the fourth tone.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Cài hěn hǎochī, bùguò yǒudiǎn guì.
What color do you like?: The food is tasty, but a bit pricey.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Although: 虽然…，但是… . Chinese puts 但是 or 可是 in the second clause, where English has no "but". 虽然 comes before the subject or the verb.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 虽然很累，但是我很开心。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 雖然很累，但是我很開心。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Suīrán hěn lèi, dànshì wǒ hěn kāixīn.
What color do you like?: Although I'm tired, I'm very happy.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: And also, moreover: it adds another point to the first: 菜很好吃，而且不贵. It goes between clauses. After 不但 it forms the pair 不但…，而且… "not only…but also…".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Cài hěn hǎochī, érqiě bù guì.
What color do you like?: The food is tasty, and not expensive too.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Not only: 不但…，而且… . 不但 stands before the verb if the subject is the same: 他不但会说，而且会写. If the subjects differ, put it before the first subject.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā bùdàn huì shuō, érqiě huì xiě.
What color do you like?: He can not only speak but also write.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: If: 如果…，就… . The result clause usually has 就 or 会. 如果 starts the "if" clause: 如果明天下雨，我就不去. It can be followed by 的话 at the end, to say the same thing again.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 如果明天下雨，我就不去。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 如果明天下雨，我就不去。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Rúguǒ míngtiān xià yǔ, wǒ jiù bù qù.
What color do you like?: If it rains tomorrow, I won't go.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: If, put at the end of the "if" clause: 你有空的话，请来. It can team up with 如果 at the front. 话 is a "word", so it is literally "in the words of…". The 的 and 话 are said light: dehuà.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ yǒu kòng dehuà, qǐng lái.
What color do you like?: If you are free, please come.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: As long as, a condition that is enough: 只要…，就… . 只要你来，我就高兴 "as long as you come, I'm happy". The first clause gives the condition and the second begins with 就.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhǐyào nǐ lái, wǒ jiù gāoxìng.
What color do you like?: As long as you come, I'll be happy.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Or, for offering choices in statements. It is a bit more written than 或者. Both names two options: 你可以走路或坐车. Questions use 还是 instead.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ kěyǐ zǒulù huò zuò chē.
What color do you like?: You can walk or take a car.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Or in a statement: 我喝茶或者咖啡都可以. In a question, "or" is 还是: 你喝茶还是咖啡？ The two words are not interchangeable. 或者 can also mean "perhaps" at the start of a sentence.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 我喝茶或者咖啡都可以。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 我喝茶或者咖啡都可以。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ hē chá huòzhě kāfēi dōu kěyǐ.
What color do you like?: I'm fine with tea or coffee.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: For example, followed by what you give: 比如苹果. 比 ("compare") plus 如 ("be like"). It leads a list or a single example.
What color do you like?: I like fruit, for example apples.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: For example, 比如 with 说 added, which is the spoken form. A comma can follow it, like the English "say,": 比如说，你可以去北京.
What color do you like?: For example, you could go to Beijing.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: For example, the written form, more formal than 比如. It is followed by examples: 例如北京和上海. 例 means "example" and 如 "like". It tends to appear in reports and textbooks.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 我去过很多地方，例如北京和上海。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 我去過很多地方，例如北京和上海。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ qù guo hěn duō dìfang, lìrú Běijīng hé Shànghǎi.
What color do you like?: I have been to many places, for example Beijing and Shanghai.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Example: 举个例子 or 举一个例子 "give an example". It follows 举 ("raise"), as in 举手. 例 is made of 亻 (person) and 列 as the sound part (liè). The 子 is light: lìzi.
Classroom: 教 ("teach") plus 室 ("room"). It is the room itself, so 在教室里 "in the classroom". 室 is also in other rooms, such as 办公室 "office". Compare 课堂, which is the class as an event.
Class, lesson time, the setting of a lesson: 课堂上 "in class". Where 教室 is the room, 课堂 is what happens in it.
Blackboard: 黑 ("black") plus 板 ("board"). 请看黑板 is what a teacher says. 擦黑板 is "wipe the board". 板 has 木 ("wood") on the left, and the sound part 反 is read fǎn.
Pen, pencil in general: any writing tool, with 支 as the measure word: 一支笔. The simplified 笔 is 竹 ("bamboo") over 毛 ("hair"), like a brush; the traditional 筆 has 聿 under the bamboo.
Notes taken at a lecture: 记笔记 "take notes". 笔 ("pen") plus 记 ("record"), so what is written down. The word is also a noun for written notes, as in 笔记很全.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ zài kè shang jì bǐjì.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Notebook, the paper kind, and also a laptop when it is used with 电脑: 笔记本电脑. In speech 笔记本 on its own can mean the laptop too, so the context decides.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ mǎi le yī ge bǐjìběn.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Homework: 做作业 or 写作业 "do homework". 作业 is not counted with 个; use 份 or 项. It can also be assigned work in general, as in 布置作业 "assign homework".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ de zuòyè hái méi xiě wán.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Composition, essay written at school or in an exam: 写作文 "write an essay". 作 ("make") plus 文 ("writing"). A short piece of writing for class is 作文, not a research paper.
What color do you like?: The teacher has us write an essay.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Question, problem on a test or exercise: 这道题 "this question", with 道 as the measure word. Compare 问题, which is any question or issue. 题 is also "title, topic": 题目.
Hard problem, difficult question: 难 ("hard") plus 题 ("problem"). 一个难题 "a tough problem". 解决难题 is "solve a hard problem".
Score, mark in an exam: 分 ("point") plus 数 ("number"). 分数高 "a high score". Compare 成绩, which means results more broadly.
Results, grades, achievement: 他的成绩很好 "his grades are good". 成 ("become") plus 绩 ("achievement"). It is broader than 分数, which is one particular score. It is also used for work results.
Examinee, test taker: 考 ("test") plus 生 ("student"). It is for people taking a formal exam, such as the 高考 college entrance exam. 考生 also appears on exam notices.
Review, revise what was learned before: 复习课文 "review the text". The first character 复 means "repeat". It is the opposite of 预习 "preview".
你喜欢什么颜色？: 我明天考试，现在要复习。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 我明天考試，現在要複習。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ míngtiān kǎoshì, xiànzài yào fùxí.
What color do you like?: I have an exam tomorrow, so I must review now.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Practice, exercise: a verb (练习写汉字) and a noun (做练习 "do exercises"). 练 ("train") plus 习 ("practice"). Used for skills you improve by repeating them.
What color do you like?: I practice writing characters every day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Practice, train, often before the thing practiced: 练字 "practice handwriting", 练球 "practice a ball game". It also stands in 练习 "practice".
Internship, work experience: 实习生 is an intern. 实 ("real") plus 习 ("practice"): practice in real work. It is used as a verb: 在公司实习.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā zài yī jiā gōngsī shíxí.
What color do you like?: He is doing an internship at a company.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Grade, year in school: 一年级 "first grade", 三年级 "third grade". 年 ("year") plus 级 ("level"). Put the number before it. 大三 is the short form for the third year of university.
Sign up, register: 报 ("report") plus 名 ("name"), a verb and its object: you give your name. 报名参加 "sign up to take part". 报名 + 学汉语 "sign up to study Chinese".
What color do you like?: I want to sign up to study Chinese.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Here "learn by heart, recite": 背课文 "recite a text from memory". The same 背 is also "back", read bèi (后背), and "to carry on the back", read bēi (背包). Which one is meant depends on the word it is used in.
Print with a printer: 打 ("hit") plus 印 ("press, print"). 打印机 is a printer, and 打印 + file or paper: 打印文件. 打 is used for many actions, such as 打电话 and 打球.
Level, standard of ability: 汉语水平 "Chinese level", 水平高 "high level". It also means "horizontal".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā de Hànyǔ shuǐpíng hěn gāo.
What color do you like?: His level of Chinese is very high.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Teacher as a profession: 她是一名教师 "she is a teacher". For addressing a teacher, 老师 is used instead; 教师 describes the job.
Education: a noun and a verb. 教育孩子 "to educate children", 受教育 "receive an education". 教育对孩子很重要 states the topic. It covers both school and upbringing at home.
What color do you like?: Education is very important for children.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Teaching, the activity of teachers: 教学方法 "teaching method", 教学楼 "teaching building". 教 is read jiào here. It is the teacher's side of things, and 学习 is the student's.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā de jiàoxué hěn yǒu yìsi.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Campus: 校 ("school") plus 园 ("garden, park"). 校园里 "on campus". 校园生活 is "campus life".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Xiàoyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō shù.
What color do you like?: There are many trees on campus.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Principal, president of a school: 校 ("school") plus 长 ("head"). 长 is read zhǎng in 校长. The same pattern: 班长, 院长, 组长.
What color do you like?: The principal has come to see us.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Class monitor, class leader: 班 ("class") plus 长 ("head"). The pattern is 班长, 校长, 组长. 他是我们班的班长.
Small group, team for work in class or at work: 小 ("small") plus 组 ("group"). 分小组 "divide into groups".
Group, team, and a measure word for a set: 一组 "a group" or "a set". 三个人一组 "three people to a group". It is also a verb in 组成 "form".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tāmen sān ge rén yī zǔ.
What color do you like?: They are in groups of three.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Group leader: 组 ("group") plus 长 ("head"), as in 班长 and 校长. The head of a work team, a study group or a team in a project.
Be made up of, form: 这个班由二十人组成 "this class is made up of twenty people". 由 introduces what it is made of, and 组成 goes after it. 成 shows the result.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhège bān yóu èrshí rén zǔchéng.
What color do you like?: This class is made up of twenty people.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Primary and secondary schools together: 中小学生 are the pupils. A short way to say 中学 and 小学. 中小学 is the term used in notices.
What color do you like?: Primary and secondary schools have a holiday today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Senior high school: 高 ("high") plus 中 ("middle school"). 高一, 高二, 高三 are the three years. The lower stage is 初中. 他在上高中 says he is in high school.
International student, student abroad: 留 ("stay") plus 学生. 留学 means to study in another country. A 留学生 is someone studying abroad, whether a foreigner in China or a Chinese person elsewhere.

Subject, department, field: in school, a 科 is a subject. 你最喜欢哪一科？ is "which subject do you like best?" It is also a medical department, as in 内科 and 外科. The word often appears inside others, as in 科学.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ zuì xǐhuan nǎ yī kē?
What color do you like?: Which subject do you like best?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Science, and as an adjective "scientific": 科学家 is a scientist, 科学方法 a scientific method. It combines 科 ("subject") and 学 ("study").
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ duì kēxué hěn yǒu xìngqù.
What color do you like?: I am very interested in science.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Physical education, sports as a school subject or a field: 体育课 is the PE class. It is the subject and activity, not a particular sport. 体 is "body" and 育 "raise, nurture". The traditional 體 has 骨 ("bone").
What color do you like?: We have PE in the afternoon.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Stadium, an open-air sports ground: 体育 ("sports") plus 场 ("field, place"). 场 turns up in other places for gathering: 广场 "square", 机场 "airport".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tǐyùchǎng lǐ yǒu hěn duō rén.
What color do you like?: There are many people in the stadium.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Gym, indoor sports hall: 体育 ("sports") plus 馆 ("hall"). 馆 is a building for a public purpose: 图书馆 "library", 饭馆 "restaurant".
What color do you like?: The match is in the sports hall.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Level, grade, rank: 三级 "level three", 年级 "school grade", 高级 "advanced". It is used for tests and ranks. 几级？ asks "which level?".
Intermediate level: 中 ("middle") plus 级 ("level"). The usual series is 初级, 中级, 高级: beginner, intermediate, advanced. Courses and exams use it: 中级汉语.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xué de shì zhōngjí Hànyǔ.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Advanced in level, and "high-end, high-class": 高级酒店 "a high-class hotel", 高级班 "advanced class". 高 ("high") plus 级 ("level").
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shì yī jiā gāojí fàndiàn.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Yard on its own: 院里 "in the yard". It is mostly part of other words: 医院 "hospital", 学院 "college", 电影院 "cinema", and also 院子. Used alone it points to a courtyard.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Yuàn lǐ yǒu yī kē shù.
What color do you like?: There is a tree in the yard.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Head of an institution such as a hospital, college or research institute: 院 ("institution") plus 长 ("head"). Same pattern as 校长 and 班长.
What color do you like?: She is the head of the hospital.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Word, a unit of language that can have one or more characters: 词 is a word, 字 is a character. 生词 is a new word, and 词典 a dictionary. 这个词的意思 is "the meaning of this word".
Words and expressions, a general term for vocabulary: 学习词语 "learn vocabulary". It covers words and short set phrases, but it is the name for the group, not a single item.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒmen xué le hěn duō xīn cíyǔ.
What color do you like?: We learned a lot of new words.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Dictionary for words, which are often more than one character. 查词典 "look up in a dictionary". A 字典 is for single characters. In everyday talk the two are often used for either.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ yòng cídiǎn chá zhège cí.
What color do you like?: I look this word up in a dictionary.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Character dictionary: 字 ("character") plus 典 ("standard book"). 查字典 "look in a dictionary". It lists single characters, while 词典 lists words.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhège zì wǒ yào chá zìdiǎn.
What color do you like?: I need to look this character up in the dictionary.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: New word in vocabulary you have not yet learned: 生 ("raw, unfamiliar") plus 词. The list of new words at the end of a lesson is 生词表.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Kèwén lǐ yǒu hěn duō shēngcí.
What color do you like?: There are many new words in the text.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: The measure word for sentences and lines of speech: 一句话 "one sentence", 说一句 "say a sentence". For the sentence as a unit of grammar, the word is 句子. The 口 ("mouth") inside it points to speech.
Sentence as a unit of language: 造句 "make a sentence", 写句子 "write sentences". Counted with 个 or 句: 一个句子. The 子 is light: jùzi.
Pronunciation of a character or word: 读 ("read aloud") plus 音 ("sound"). 这个字的读音 asks how to say that character.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhège zì de dúyīn shì shénme?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Syllable: 音 ("sound") plus 节 ("section"). In Chinese almost every character is one syllable, so 你好 has two syllables.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhège cí yǒu sān ge yīnjié.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: English the language, with 文 ("writing") that stresses the written form: 写英文 "write English". 英语 is more the spoken language, though the two overlap a lot. The 英 is for England.
English, the language, with 语 ("spoken language"). 说英语 "speak English". 英文 leans toward writing, but the two are close and often used for the same school subject.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā shuō Yīngyǔ shuō de hěn hǎo.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Standard Mandarin: 说普通话 "speak Mandarin". The name literally means "common speech". In Taiwan people usually just say 中文; the official name there, 国语, sounds formal or old-fashioned.
Language: 学语言 "study languages", 语言学 "linguistics". 语 ("speech") plus 言 ("words"). Specific languages have their own names, such as 汉语 and 英语.
Dialogue, conversation: a text of two speakers in a language book (读对话 "read the dialogue"), or a talk between sides. 对 ("facing") plus 话 ("speech").
Speak, tell, explain: 讲故事 "tell a story", 讲课 "give a lesson", 讲道理 "reason with someone". It puts weight on telling or explaining, where 说 is simply "say".
What color do you like?: The teacher is telling a story.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Speak, give a talk: a verb and its object, 讲 ("speak") plus 话. 他在讲话 "he is speaking" in front of people. It is also the noun "a speech": 重要讲话.
What color do you like?: He is speaking on the stage.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Listen to a lecture, pay attention in class: 听 ("listen") plus 讲 ("lecture"). A teacher says 认真听讲 "listen carefully".
I hear that…, "it is said that…": 听说 + the news: 听说他回国了. It starts a sentence. The same two characters also appear as "listening and speaking" in 听说读写.
What color do you like?: I hear it will snow tomorrow.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Explain, show and "explanation, instructions": 说明书 is a manual. 说 ("say") plus 明 ("clear"): say clearly. As a verb it takes 一下: 说明一下. It can also mean "prove, indicate".
Meaning: 什么意思 "what does it mean?" It has a second sense, "a gesture, a small token": 一点意思 "a little something". Said yìsi with a light 思. 意思 also appears in 不好意思 and 有意思.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ shuō de shì shénme yìsi?
What color do you like?: What do you mean by that?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Interesting, fun: 有 ("have") plus 意思. 很有意思 says a book, film or person is interesting. The opposite is 没意思 "boring, dull".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè běn shū hěn yǒu yìsi.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Opinion, view, and "objection" in 有意见. 你有什么意见？ asks for an opinion. 提意见 is to give suggestions or complaints. 见 is read jiàn.
Express, show, and "indicate": 表示感谢 "express thanks", 表示同意 "show agreement". It is somewhat formal. 表 ("outer") plus 示 ("show").

Table, form, chart: 填表 "fill in a form", 时间表 "timetable". The traditional script writes this 表, but for a watch it writes 錶 (手錶), a character made around 1900 for that meaning. In simplified characters both are 表.
Lamp, light: 开灯 "turn on the light", 关灯 "turn it off". Also in 红绿灯 "traffic light". The simplified 灯 has 火 ("fire") and 丁 (dīng); the traditional 燈 has 登 as the sound part, which gives dēng.
Chair: 一把椅子. Measure word 把, which is also used for things with a handle. The 子 is light: yǐzi. 椅 has 木 ("wood") on the left and 奇 as the sound part.
Wall of a house or a courtyard. 墙上 "on the wall".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Qiáng shang yǒu yī zhāng dìtú.
What color do you like?: There is a map on the wall.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Main gate, front door: 大 ("big") plus 门. It is the gate of a school, a compound or a building. The door of a room is just 门.
Washing machine: 洗衣 ("wash clothes") plus 机 ("machine"). The pattern 洗衣机 is the same as 打印机 "printer" and 手机 "mobile phone". 机 is "machine".
Paper: 一张纸 "a sheet of paper". 张 is the measure word. 纸 has 纟 ("silk") on the left. 纸 appears in 报纸 "newspaper" too.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī zhāng zhǐ.
What color do you like?: Please give me a sheet of paper.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Wristwatch: 手 ("hand") plus 表 ("watch"). Traditional writing uses 錶 for the watch, with 金 ("metal"): 手錶. Measure word: 块 or 只. 戴手表 "wear a watch".
Shoe, shoes: 一双鞋 "a pair of shoes", with 双 as the measure word. The 革 ("leather") on the left shows the material. 穿鞋 "put on shoes", 脱鞋 "take off shoes".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng xīn xié.
What color do you like?: I'd like to buy a new pair of shoes.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Overcoat: 大 ("big") plus 衣 ("clothing"), a long, warm coat. 穿大衣 "wear a coat". Measure word: 件.
What color do you like?: It's cold outside, put on a coat.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Gift, present: 送礼物 "give a gift", 生日礼物 "birthday present". 礼 means "courtesy". Measure word: 个 or 份.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shì gěi nǐ de lǐwù.
What color do you like?: This is a present for you.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Computer, the formal name, from 计算 ("calculate") plus 机 ("machine"). In daily talk 电脑 is the usual word. 计算机 also names the subject: 计算机专业.
Camera: 相机 is short for 照相机. 用相机照相 "take pictures with a camera". 机 is "machine". The 相 is read xiàng here, "image", and xiāng in 相信.
What color do you like?: I take photos with a camera.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Housing, living space: 住 ("live") plus 房 ("house"). It is the dwelling as a thing: 住房问题 "the housing problem". 房子 is the building itself.
What color do you like?: Their living space is very small.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Card: 银行卡 "bank card", 信用卡 "credit card", 电话卡 "phone card". Counted with 张.
What color do you like?: I forgot to bring my bank card.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Pack, load, put into: 装进包里 "put in the bag", 装满 "fill up". It also means "install" and "dress up" in some words. 衣 ("clothes") is the meaning part at the bottom.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā bǎ shū zhuāng jìn bāo lǐ.
What color do you like?: She put the books into her bag.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bring, take along, for things and people: 带手机 "bring a phone", 带孩子 "take the child". It carries along with you; with a direction, 带来 and 带去. Also "belt, zone".
What color do you like?: Don't forget to bring your phone.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bring (here): 带 plus 来 gives direction toward the speaker. 带来礼物 "bring a gift". It can also mean "bring about, lead to": 带来快乐.
What color do you like?: Thank you for the gift you brought.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Seat: 座 ("seat") plus 位 ("place"). 有座位吗？ asks whether a place is free. 座位 is a seat on a bus, in a class or in a cinema. 位 is also the polite measure word for people.
Vehicles, as a group: 车 ("vehicle") plus 辆, the measure word for vehicles. 辆 follows the number: 一辆车.
What color do you like?: There are many vehicles on the road.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bus: 公共 ("public") plus 汽车 ("car"). 坐公共汽车 "take a bus". The short form is 公交车.
What color do you like?: I take the bus to school.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bus, the shorter word, from 公交 ("public transport") plus 车. 坐公交车 "take a bus". Both 公共汽车 and 公交车 are common.
What color do you like?: I take the bus to work every day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bicycle: 自行 ("by itself") plus 车. You ride it with 骑: 骑自行车. Measure word: 辆.
What color do you like?: I ride a bike to school.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Taxi: 出租 ("rent out") plus 车. 坐出租车 "take a taxi". The spoken way to say it is 打车.
Rent out (to others): 出 ("out") plus 租. The sign 出租 means "for rent". To rent something yourself, say 租: 租房子.
Subway, metro: 地 ("ground") plus 铁 ("iron"). 坐地铁 "take the subway". 铁 is also in 高铁 "high-speed train".
Subway station: 地铁 plus 站 ("station, stop"). 站 means "stand" and "station". 站 is also in 车站.
Boat, ship: 坐船 "go by boat". Measure word: 条 or 艘. The 舟 ("boat") on the left is the meaning part.
What color do you like?: We cross the river by boat.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Ride something you sit astride: a bicycle, a horse or a motorbike: 骑马, 骑车. For a bus or a train, use 坐, and for driving a car, use 开. The traditional 騎 has 馬 ("horse"); the simplified 骑 has 马.
Ride a bicycle: 骑 ("ride") plus 车, a verb and its object. It is used for bicycles and motorbikes. 骑车去上班 "ride to work".
Stop: 雨停了 "the rain has stopped", and "park". It can be used for things that move: 车停了. With 在 it gives a place: 停在门口 "park at the door". 亻 ("person") is on the left.
Park a car, or "stop the vehicle": verb and object, 停 plus 车. 停车场 is a car park. A sign says 禁止停车 "no parking".
Parking lot, car park: 停车 ("park") plus 场 ("place, field"). 场 turns up in other open places: 体育场, 机场. 停车场 may be outdoors or underground.
Driver as a job: of a taxi, bus or truck. 出租车司机 is a taxi driver. 司机 is the person; the act of driving is 开车.
What color do you like?: The driver is waiting for us.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Traffic, transport: 交通很方便 "transport is convenient", 交通事故 "traffic accident". It covers roads, buses, trains and so on, as a system. Here 交 means "cross, link".
Highway, road for vehicles, especially between towns: 公 ("public") plus 路. 高速公路 is an expressway.
Road, path: a more formal and general word than 路. 道路 can be a real road and also a figurative path: 人生的道路 "the path of life". Counted with 条.
What color do you like?: There are trees on both sides of the road.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Roadside: 路 ("road") plus 边 ("side"). 在路边 "at the roadside", 路边的店 "a roadside shop".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā bǎ chē tíng zài lùbiān.
What color do you like?: He parked the car by the roadside.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Ask the way, a verb and its object: 问 ("ask") plus 路 ("road"). 向…问路 "ask someone the way". You can also say 问一下路.
Take off of a plane: 起 ("rise") plus 飞 ("fly"). Its opposite is 降落 "land". The subject is the plane: 飞机起飞. Times go before it.
What color do you like?: The plane takes off at ten.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: The north, and "the northern part" of a country: 北方人 "a northerner". 北 ("north") plus 方 ("direction, region").
What color do you like?: Winter in the north is cold.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: The south, and "the southern part" of a country: 南方人 "a southerner". 南方 is a region, while 南边 is a nearby side.
The East, the Orient: 东方 ("east") plus 方. It is the East as a region or culture: 东方文化 "Eastern culture". The opposite is 西方.
The West, meaning Western countries, as against 东方: 西方国家 "Western countries". It is also the direction "west". Compare 西边, "the west side".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā qù guo hěn duō xīfāng guójiā.
What color do you like?: He has been to many Western countries.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Northeast, and the Northeast of China (东北). In Chinese the combined direction puts 东 or 西 first, then 北 or 南: 东北, 东南, 西北, 西南, the reverse of English "north-east".
What color do you like?: Winters in the northeast are cold.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Southeast: 东 first, then 南, the reverse of the English order "south-east". Same pattern as 东北. Used for directions and areas: 城市的东南.
What color do you like?: The school is in the southeast of the city.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Northwest: 西 first, then 北. Mind the order, which is the reverse of the English: 西北, not 北西. 西北 also names a region of China.
What color do you like?: The weather in the northwest is very dry.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Southwest: 西 first, then 南, like 西北. 西南 also names a region of China. 中国的西南 "southwest China".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhōngguó de xīnán yǒu hěn duō shān.
What color do you like?: There are many mountains in southwest China.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Direction: 方 ("direction") plus 向 ("toward"). 走错方向 "go the wrong way". It is also a figurative aim: 努力的方向 "direction of effort". 方向 is the thing, and 往 or 向 the preposition.
Opposite, across from: 在…对面 "opposite to…". 面 is read full: duìmiàn. 对面 can also be the person or place opposite: 对面的人.
What color do you like?: The bank is opposite the school.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: In front of, mostly with a person: 在他面前 "in front of him". 面前 describes what is before someone's eyes, and not a place far off. Used for figurative situations too: 困难面前 "in the face of difficulty".
What color do you like?: He stands in front of me.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Inside, the spoken word: 里 ("inside") plus a light 头, lǐtou. 里头 is like 里面 and often a bit more colloquial.
What color do you like?: There is somebody inside the room.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: A light suffix on words of direction and place: 前头 "in front", 里头 "inside", 上头 "above". Said tou, light and with no tone. It is the same character as 头 "head" in 头发 (tóu), but a different, light use.
What color do you like?: There is a bank up ahead.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: A word-ending of direction words, as in 东边 "east side", 左边 "left side" and 旁边 "next to". Here 边 is read with the first tone, biān, in this entry. It may also stand on its own: 边…边… "while…".
What color do you like?: The book is to the left of the table.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Side, surface in 上面 and 外面, and a measure word for meetings: 见一面 "meet once". In traditional characters 面 is "face, surface, side", and noodles are 麵. This is why 方便面 is 方便麵 there.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jiàn guo tā yī miàn.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Toward, to, before a verb of movement: 往前走 "go forward", 往左拐 "turn left". The direction goes after 往. It shows where you head. Compare 向, which can also be followed by a person.
Toward and "from": 向前走 is "go forward", and 向你学习 "learn from you". With a person it means "to, from", as in 向他问好. Unlike 往, it can lead to a person. Another sense of 向 is "direction", as in 方向.
What color do you like?: I want to learn from you.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Everywhere: 到 ("reach") plus 处 ("place"). 到处都是 "it is everywhere". It goes before the verb. 处 is read chù.
Walk past, walk by: 走 plus 过. 他从我身边走过 "he walked past me". In this word 过 is read guò with its full tone. The place passed follows 从: 从…走过.
Walk into: 走 plus 进. 走进教室 "walk into the classroom". The place follows directly, with no 到. The opposite is 走出.
What color do you like?: The teacher walks into the classroom.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Go away, move aside: 走 plus 开. As a command it is blunt, like "go away": 走开！ Used with 请 it asks someone to step aside.
What color do you like?: Please step aside for a moment.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Stop! or "stand still": 站 plus 住. 住 shows holding firm. 站住！ is what you shout to someone who is running.
Put down: 放 plus 下, 把书放下 "put the book down". It can also mean "give up": 放下工作 "put one's work aside".
Beside oneself, around one: 身 ("body") plus 边 ("side"). 在我身边 "by my side".
What color do you like?: The child is by my side.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Travel, trip: 旅 ("travel") plus 行 ("go"). 去旅行 "go on a trip". 旅行 is travel as a journey, and the trip itself can be long or short. It is close to 旅游, the pleasure trip.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xǐhuan yī ge rén lǚxíng.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Travel for pleasure, tourism: 去北京旅游. 旅 ("travel") plus 游 ("tour"). The traditional 旅遊 uses 遊, and 游 is "swim" there: 游泳.
What color do you like?: We are going to Beijing on a trip.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Traveler, passenger in the written style of stations and notices: 各位旅客 "dear passengers". 旅 ("travel") plus 客 ("guest"). The 游客 is a tourist.
Tourist: 游 ("tour") plus 客 ("guest"). 游客很多 "there are many tourists". It names someone on a pleasure trip, as against 旅客, who is simply traveling.
Passport: 护 ("protect") plus 照 ("certificate"). 办护照 "apply for a passport". 出国要带护照 states the rule.
What color do you like?: You need a passport to go abroad.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Go abroad: 出 ("go out of") plus 国 ("country"), a verb and its object. 出国留学 "go abroad to study". The traditional 國 holds 或, and the simplified 国 holds 玉 ("jade").
What color do you like?: I want to go abroad to study.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Return to one's own country: 回 ("return") plus 国. 他下个月回国 "he goes home next month".
What color do you like?: He goes back to his country next month.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Set out, depart: 出 ("out") plus 发 ("send out"). 我们明天出发 "we set off tomorrow". In traditional characters 发 is 發, so the word is 出發. The "hair" 发 is 髮 in traditional characters.
Go out of the house: a verb and its object, 出 ("out") plus 门 ("door"). 她已经出门了 "she has already gone out". It can also mean "go on a trip": 出门在外 "away from home".
International: 国 ("country") plus 际 ("between"). It sits before the noun: 国际机场, 国际电话.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shì yī ge guójì jīchǎng.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Another place, outside the local area: 外地人 is someone not from here. 外 ("outside") plus 地 ("place"). It means somewhere else in the country, not abroad.
What color do you like?: He comes from out of town.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Come from, for origin: 我来自北京 "I come from Beijing". It is somewhat formal. The place follows directly.
Visit, tour a place to look around, such as a museum or a factory: 参观博物馆. 参 is read cān here. It is not used for visiting a person.
What color do you like?: We go to visit the school.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Come over, toward the speaker: 你过来 "come here". 过来 is also a complement showing a direction: 走过来.
What color do you like?: Come over here for a moment.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Go over to another place, away from the speaker: 我过去看看. The same word can also mean "the past": 过去的事 "past matters". Compare 过来, which is toward the speaker.
What color do you like?: I'll go over and take a look.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Away from, measuring distance: A 离 B 很近 "A is close to B". 离 states a distance, and not movement. 公园离这里不远 uses it. 从 states a starting point instead.
What color do you like?: The park isn't far from here.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Leave, depart from: 离开北京 "leave Beijing". The place or person left follows. It is a verb of movement, unlike 离, which measures distance.
Exit: 出 ("out") plus 口 ("opening"). Signs say 出口 and the opposite 入口. It can also mean "export", but the first sense is the exit. 口 is "mouth" and "opening".
Entrance: 入 ("enter") plus 口 ("opening"). The sign is 入口, opposite 出口. 入 looks like 人 ("person"), but the two are different characters.
What color do you like?: The entrance is on this side.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Enter, the formal word, taking a place directly: 进入教室 "enter the classroom". 进入 also fits abstract things: 进入新年 "enter the new year". 进 alone is the plain everyday word.
Exceed, overtake: 超过 + number or person. 他超过了我 "he overtook me". 超过十个人 "more than ten people".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā de chéngjì chāoguò le wǒ.
What color do you like?: His grades are better than mine.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Pass through, go past, and "go through" an experience: 经过公园 "pass the park", 经过考试 "go through an exam". The place passed follows it directly. 经 has 纟 ("thread") and means "pass through" in many words.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ měitiān jīngguò zhè jiā diàn.
What color do you like?: I pass this shop every day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Pass through, "by means of", and "pass" a test: 通过考试 "pass an exam", 通过网络 "via the internet". It can also be a preposition before a method.
Supermarket: 超 ("super") plus 市 ("market"), short for 超级市场. 去超市买菜 "go to the supermarket to buy groceries". 市 on its own is "city" or "market".
What color do you like?: I go to the supermarket to buy groceries.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Shop, store: the measure word is 家: 一家店. 店 also ends many words for kinds of shops: 书店 "bookshop", 商店 "store", 饭店. 店 has 广 ("building") on the outside.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè jiā diàn shí diǎn kāimén.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Hotel, although the characters mean "liquor shop": 酒 ("alcohol") plus 店 ("shop"). 住酒店 "stay at a hotel". A 酒店 is usually more upscale than a 宾馆 or a 旅馆.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒmen zhù zài zhè jiā jiǔdiàn.
What color do you like?: We are staying at this hotel.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bank. 行 is read háng here, "business", not xíng as in 行人. 银 ("silver") plus 行. 去银行取钱 "go to the bank for money". The traditional 銀行 has 金 ("metal") in 銀.
What color do you like?: What time does the bank open?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Bank card, with 卡 ("card"): 银行 plus 卡. Measure word 张: 一张银行卡.
What color do you like?: Do you have a bank card?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Credit card: 信用 ("credit, trust") plus 卡. 可以用信用卡吗？ is a question to ask a shop.
What color do you like?: Can I use a credit card?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Customer: 顾 ("look after") plus 客 ("guest"). 顾客 is the word used by shops and services. 客 is the same as in 客人.
