Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Diàn lǐ yǒu hěn duō gùkè.
What color do you like?: There are many customers in the shop.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Service, and "serve": 服务员 is a waiter or attendant. 服务很好 "the service is good". 为客人服务 "serve guests".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè jiā diàn de fúwù hěn hǎo.
What color do you like?: The service in this shop is very good.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Cheap, inexpensive: the second syllable is light, piányi. 便 is read pián here, but biàn in 方便. The opposite is 贵. 便宜一点 "a bit cheaper" is what you ask when bargaining.
What color do you like?: This piece of clothing is cheap.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Sell. 卖 is 买 ("buy") with 十 on top, so the tone is also different: mài against mǎi. The traditional 賣 has 買 ("buy") underneath. 卖 + thing: 卖水果. 在卖 "selling".
Rent something from someone: 租房子 "rent a house". The one who rents it out uses 出租. The same 租 is in 房租, "rent", the money paid. Context shows which side you are on.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng zū yī ge fángzi.
What color do you like?: I'd like to rent a place.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Income: 收 ("take in") plus 入 ("enter"). 他的收入不高 "his income is not high". 月收入 is monthly income. 收入 can also be a verb, "to take in".
Take, fetch, withdraw: 取钱 "withdraw money", 取包裹 "pick up a parcel". The thing taken follows it.
What color do you like?: I'm going to the bank to withdraw money.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Change, exchange: 换钱 "exchange money", 换衣服 "change clothes", 换一个 "swap for another".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng huàn yī jiàn dà de.
What color do you like?: I'd like to change it for a bigger one.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Enough: 钱够了 "there is enough money". 够 + adjective gives "enough": 够大 "big enough". 够了 can mean "that's enough!"
Not enough: 不 plus 够. 钱不够 "the money is not enough". After an adjective: 不够大 "not big enough". The tone of 不 is bù in dictionaries.
What color do you like?: The money isn't enough, what shall I do?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Businessperson, merchant: 商 ("trade") plus 人. 商人 is a person who does business, often one who sells goods. 商 is also in 商店.
Manager: 经理 is a job title, put after the surname: 王经理 "Manager Wang". It can be used for managers of shops, hotels, companies.
What color do you like?: The manager is not in today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Receive, accept, collect: 收到 "receive", 收钱 "take payment", 收东西 "put things away". 收到 is the most common: 收到信 "got the letter".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ shōudào wǒ de xìn le ma?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Borrow and also "lend". 借你的书 is "borrow your book". To lend, add 给: 借给我 "lend to me". 向 or 跟 introduces the person you borrow from. The context makes clear which.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng jiè nǐ de shū.
What color do you like?: I'd like to borrow your book.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Square, plaza: 广 ("wide") plus 场 ("place"). 天安门广场 is a well-known one. The simplified 广 is the top part of the traditional 廣, whose 黄 gives the sound; 廣場.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Guǎngchǎng shang yǒu hěn duō rén.
What color do you like?: There are many people on the square.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Street: a city street, the road with its shops: 大街 "main street", 上街 "go out on the street". 街上 "on the street". 路 is the broader word for a road.
What color do you like?: Let's take a walk on the street.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: City as an administrative unit and a place name ending: 北京市, 上海市. 市 also means "market": 超市. 城市 is the general word for a city. 市 is also "municipal": 市中心 "city center".
Mayor: 市 ("city") plus 长 ("head"). Read zhǎng. The pattern is the same as 校长, 班长 and 院长.
What color do you like?: The mayor is coming to the school today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Before, in the past: 以前我住在这里 "I used to live here". After a time, "ago": 三年以前. 以前 can start a sentence. Its opposite is 以后.
After, later: 下课以后 "after class". It follows the event. The traditional 後 is not the same as 后: in traditional script 后 is "queen" or "empress" only. 後 has 彳 ("step") on the left.
What color do you like?: After class we go to eat.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Above, more than: 十岁以上 "ten years and over". 以上 counts the number itself: 十岁以上 includes ten-year-olds. It can also mean "the above". The opposite is 以下.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Shí suì yǐshàng de rén kěyǐ lái.
What color do you like?: People aged ten and over can come.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Below, under: 十度以下 "below ten degrees". 以下 counts the number itself. It can also mean "the following": 以下是… "what follows is…". Its opposite is 以上.
What color do you like?: Today it is ten degrees or below.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Outside of, apart from: 除了…以外 "apart from…". Often with 都 or 还. It can also mean "beyond" in a place: 城市以外.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 除了我以外，大家都去了。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 除了我以外，大家都去了。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Chúle wǒ yǐwài, dàjiā dōu qù le.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: From now on, in future: 今 ("now") plus 后 ("after"). Starts a clause about the future. It is more formal than 以后.
What color do you like?: From now on I'll come every day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Afterwards, later, used only about the past. 后来他去了北京 "later he went to Beijing". For the future, say 以后.
Then, after that, in a sequence of actions: 先…，然后… "first…, then…". 然后 goes at the start of the second step.
What color do you like?: First we eat, then we see a film.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: At that time in the past: 当时我才十岁 "I was only ten then". 当 is read dāng here.
What color do you like?: At that time I was only ten.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: At the same time: 他同时学两种语言. 同 is "same".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā tóngshí xué liǎng zhǒng yǔyán.
What color do you like?: He studies two languages at the same time.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Usually, in ordinary times, as against special days or the present moment: 我平时七点起床. It goes before the verb.
What color do you like?: Normally I get up at seven.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: At that time: 那 ("that") plus 时. Shorter and more written than 那时候. It sets up a past time: 那时我还小.
At that time, the fuller, spoken form: 那时候我住在上海. Like 那时 but with 候. The light 候 gives nàshíhou.
What color do you like?: At that time I lived in Shanghai.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: At that time, the spoken form with the ending 儿: nàhuìr. 那会儿我还没上学. It is the same as 那时候.
What color do you like?: At that time I was not yet in school.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: At this moment, just then: 这 ("this") plus 时. Often starts a sentence in a story: 这时，电话响了.
At this time, the spoken form with 候: 这时候你在做什么？ Same meaning as 这时.
What color do you like?: What are you doing at this time?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Then, next, the following step: 接着 + verb: 接着唱歌. It also means "catch" in 接着球. The 着 is light: jiēzhe.
What color do you like?: After he spoke, he went on to sing.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Next, what comes next: 接下来我们做什么？ It starts a sentence and refers to what follows. 接 ("connect") plus 下来 ("on down").
What to do?: the question for a problem. 怎么办？ stands alone as a full sentence. 办 is "handle".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ wàng le dài qián, zěnmebàn?
What color do you like?: I forgot my money, what shall I do?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: How about…?, "how is it?": 你的新家怎么样？ Used to ask for an opinion or state. Also 怎么样 at the end of a suggestion: 我们去看电影，怎么样？
How, more written than 怎么样: 怎样写 "how to write". It asks the way something is done.
What kind of: 什么样的人 "what kind of person". It asks for a description. 样 means "kind, shape".
What color do you like?: What kind of person do you like?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Why: it goes before the verb, in the position of the reason: 你为什么不去？ The answer starts with 因为. 为 is read wèi.
For, for the sake of, read wèi: 为你高兴 "be glad for you". It is also wéi in 成为 "become". 为 is part of 为什么 and 因为.
Like this, so: 这样做 "do it like this", 这样的人 "this kind of person". 就这样吧 "let's leave it at that".
Like that: 那样做 "do it like that", opposite of 这样. 不要那样做 is "don't do that".
The same, equally: 同样的问题 "the same problem", and before a verb or adjective, 同样重要 "just as important". 同 ("same") plus 样 ("kind, appearance").
It seems, as if: 好像 + clause: 好像要下雨了 "it looks like rain". It states an impression. It is related to 像, "be like".
What color do you like?: It looks like it's going to rain.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Be like, resemble: 他很像他爸爸 "he looks like his father". It also lists examples: 像苹果、香蕉这样的水果.亻 ("person") is the meaning part and 象 the sound part, and 象 also means "elephant".
What color do you like?: He looks a lot like his father.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Appearance, look, manner: 他笑的样子 "the way he smiles". 看样子 means "by the look of it". The 子 is light: yàngzi. 样 is "kind, shape".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā xiào de yàngzi hěn kě'ài.
What color do you like?: The way he smiles is very cute.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Young person, youth in the sense of a young adult, as against 少年: 青年人. 青 means "green, young" here.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Hěn duō qīngnián xǐhuan zhè shǒu gē.
What color do you like?: Many young people like this song.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Teenager, young boy, young person: 少 is read shào here ("young"), not shǎo ("few"). A 少年 is younger than a 青年.
Teenagers, young people: 青年 plus 少年 joined. 青少年 as a group: 青少年要多运动.
Middle age: 中 ("middle") plus 年. 中年人 "a middle-aged person". The stages are 少年, 青年, 中年, 老年.
Old age, the elderly: 老年人 "old people". The last of 少年, 青年, 中年, 老年.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Gōngyuán lǐ yǒu hěn duō lǎonián rén.
What color do you like?: There are many old people in the park.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Young, for people: 她看起来很年轻 "she looks young". 年轻人 means "young people". It is said of grown people, not of small children. 年 ("year") plus 轻 ("light").
Be born: 我出生在北京 "I was born in Beijing". 出 ("out") plus 生 ("birth"). It names the event, and the place or year follows. 出生日期 is "date of birth".

Give birth to, "be born", "raw", "student" and more. As a verb: 生孩子 "have a baby", 生病 "fall ill", 生气 "get angry". In 学生 it means "student". In 生词 "new word" and 生菜 "lettuce" it means "raw, unfamiliar".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā shēng le yī ge nǚ'ér.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Grow and "senior, head", read zhǎng: 孩子长得真快 "the child grows fast". 校长 "principal" and 家长 "parent" use the same 长, meaning "chief, elder". As "long", the same character is read cháng.
What color do you like?: The child is growing so fast.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Grow up: 长 ("grow") plus 大. 长大后 "after growing up". 我长大要当医生 "when I grow up I want to be a doctor".
What color do you like?: When I grow up I want to be a doctor.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: A whole life: 一 ("one") plus 生 ("life"). 他一生 or 一生都 "all his life".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā yīshēng dōu zài xuéxiào gōngzuò.
What color do you like?: He worked at the school all his life.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Life in the sense of everyday living, and "to live": 生活很好 "life is good", 在北京生活 "live in Beijing". It is broader than 住, which means "to live at a place".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ zài Běijīng shēnghuó le wǔ nián.
What color do you like?: I have lived in Beijing for five years.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Raise, keep animals and plants, and "support" a family: 养狗 "keep a dog", 养花 "grow flowers", 养孩子 "raise a child". The traditional 養 has 食 ("food") at the bottom, while the simplified 养 shortens that to 儿.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā jiā yǎng le liǎng zhī gǒu.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Long, read cháng: 这条河很长 "this river is long". The opposite is 短. This is the same character as zhǎng "grow, head", but pronounced differently. In 长江, the Yangtze, it is cháng too.
Thousand: 三千 "three thousand". With a single thousand, add 一: 一千 "one thousand", not 千 alone. 千 is also in 千克 "kilogram".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ yǒu yī qiān kuài qián.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Ten thousand. Chinese counts in units of 万, not thousands: 十万 is 100,000 and 五十万 is 500,000. So "two million" is 二百万. The next unit up is 亿, a hundred million.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhège chéngshì yǒu wǔshí wàn rén.
What color do you like?: This city has five hundred thousand people.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Hundred million: 一亿 is 100,000,000. Chinese counts 万 (10,000) and 亿 (100,000,000), so ten 亿 is a billion.
What color do you like?: China has over a billion people.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Kilometer: 公 ("public, metric") plus 里. 里 itself is an old Chinese mile. 三公里 "three kilometers".
What color do you like?: The school is three kilometers from here.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Kilogram: 公 plus 斤. 两公斤 "two kilograms". A 公斤 is two 斤. The form 千克 is the scientific name.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi liǎng gōngjīn píngguǒ.
What color do you like?: I'd like to buy two kilos of apples.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Jin, a Chinese unit of weight equal to half a kilogram (500 g). Markets price by the jin: 苹果多少钱一斤？ A 公斤 is two 斤. It began as a picture of an axe.
What color do you like?: How much is a jin of apples?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Gram: 五百克 "500 grams". 克 follows the number. A 斤 is 500 克.
Kilogram, the official name of the unit: 千 ("thousand") plus 克 ("gram"). 公斤 is the everyday word. 千克 appears on labels and in science.

Corner, "horn", and a unit of money, a tenth of a yuan: 五块三角 "5.30 yuan". 角 also means "angle". A tenth of a 块 is a 角, and a tenth of a 角 is a 分. It is read jiǎo in all these. It began as a picture of an animal horn.
Degree for temperature and angles: 三十度 "thirty degrees". It follows the number. Read dù.
Count, read shǔ: 数一数 "count it up". The same character is read shù in 数字 "number".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ shǔ yi shǔ yǒu jǐ ge.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Number, figure: 数 ("number") plus 字 ("character"). 数字 appears in statistics and prices, and means "digital" in 数字化. Here 数 is read shù.
Number of people: 人 plus 数. 人数很多 "there are many people".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Jīntiān lái de rénshù hěn duō.
What color do you like?: A lot of people came today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Population: 人 ("person") plus 口 ("mouth"). 人口很多 "the population is large". It counts people in a place as a whole. 口 is also the measure word for family members: 三口人.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhège chéngshì de rénkǒu hěn duō.
What color do you like?: This city has a large population.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Altogether, in total: 一共多少钱？ is the question for a total price. It goes before the verb and states a sum: 一共五个人. Dictionaries write yīgòng.
Quarter of an hour: 三点一刻 "3:15" and 三点三刻 "3:45". It also means "carve". 刻 is a clock word used with 点. The 刂 ("knife") is the meaning part, and 亥 the sound part.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Xiànzài shì sān diǎn yī kè.
What color do you like?: It is a quarter past three.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for portions, copies and jobs: 一份报纸 "a newspaper", 一份工作 "a job", 一份饭 "a meal set". 份 also means "share".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ zhǎodào le yī fèn gōngzuò.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for letters: 一封信 "a letter". It also means "to seal": 封上.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiě le yī fēng xìn.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for clothes on the upper body, for matters, and for pieces of luggage: 一件衣服, 一件事, 一件行李. For trousers use 条, and for shoes 双.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ yǒu yī jiàn shì yào shuō.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Floor, story and "layer": 五层 "the fifth floor". 一层 is the ground floor in Chinese counting. It follows the number. In traditional script it is 層, which has 曾 where the simplified 层 has 云.
What color do you like?: I live on the fifth floor.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for events and weather, in the form 一场雨 "a rain", 一场电影 "a film showing", 一场比赛 "a match". 场 is read chǎng here.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zuótiān xià le yī chǎng dàyǔ.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for vehicles: 一辆车 "a car", 两辆自行车 "two bicycles".
What color do you like?: There is a car at the door.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for long, thin things: 一条路, 一条河, 一条鱼, 一条裤子. Dogs take 条 as well as 只.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ yǎng le yī tiáo gǒu.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for a set or a suit: 一套房子 "an apartment", 一套衣服 "an outfit". 套 also means "cover".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒmen zū le yī tào fángzi.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for large, fixed things: 一座山 "a mountain", 一座桥 "a bridge", 一座城市 "a city". The same character is in 座位 "seat".
The polite measure word for people: 这位是我的老师 "this is my teacher". 一位客人 "a guest". 您几位？ is what a waiter says. It also appears in 座位 and 位子.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè wèi shì wǒ de lǎoshī.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for a stretch or a section: 一段路 "a stretch of road", 一段时间 "a period of time", 一段话 "a passage".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒmen zǒu le yī duàn lù.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Time, counting an action done through from start to end: 读一遍 "read it through once", 请再说一遍 "say it once more". 次 counts how many times; 遍 counts complete runs.
Measure word for written pieces: 一篇文章 "an article", 一篇作文 "an essay". 篇 has 竹 ("bamboo") on top.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiě le yī piān zuòwén.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Slice, flake and a measure word for flat pieces: 一片面包 "a slice of bread", 一片云 "a cloud". 片 also means "film".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Qǐng gěi wǒ yī piàn miànbāo.
What color do you like?: Please give me a slice of bread.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Name and a measure word for people in a profession: 一名学生 "a student", 一名医生 "a doctor". It is also in 名字 and 姓名.
Row, line, and a measure word for rows: 第一排 "the first row". It is also a verb: 排队 "line up". 扌 ("hand") is the meaning part.
What color do you like?: I sit in the first row.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Measure word for questions, dishes, doors and orders: 一道题 "a question", 一道菜 "a dish". Also "way, road", as in 道路.
Team, line: 他是我们队的 "he is on our team". It is also in 排队 "line up". 队 (the simplified form) is 隊 in traditional script, which has 㒸 as the sound part.
Many, the more formal word: 许多人 "many people". Spoken Chinese often says 很多 or 好多 instead.
What color do you like?: There are many people in the park.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Many, lots of, the spoken word: 好多人 "lots of people". With 了 it means "much better": 好多了.
The majority, most: 大多数人 "most people". 大 ("big") plus 多数 ("the greater number"). It goes before the noun and is followed by 都 or 是.
The majority, most: 多 ("many") plus 数 ("number"). 多数人 "most people". The opposite is 少数. It is used before a noun: 多数人都同意.
A minority, a few: 少 is read shǎo here. 少数民族 are the ethnic minorities of China. 只有少数人 "only a few people". It is the opposite of 多数.
Most of, the greater part: 大部分学生 "most of the students", 大部分时间 "most of the time". The 分 is light: dàbùfen.
What color do you like?: Most of the students have come.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Part, portion: 这部分 "this part", 一部分 "a part". Said bùfen, with a light 分. It can be a part of a whole, a section of a book, or a share of people.
A part, some: 一部分人 "some of the people". It names a share that is not the majority. Compare 大部分, which is most. Said yībùfen.
A large amount: 大量的时间 "a large amount of time". It goes before nouns and verbs and sounds formal: 大量生产. 大 plus 量 ("quantity").
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā kàn le dàliàng de shū.
What color do you like?: He has read a large number of books.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Quite a lot, not a few: 不 plus 少, a way of saying "many" by denying "few". 来了不少人 "quite a few people came". It sits before the noun. Dictionaries write bùshǎo.
What color do you like?: Quite a lot of people came.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: All, the whole: 我全部都买了 "I bought all of it". 全部 is a noun and an adverb.
All the members, the whole body: 全体同学 "all the students". It is a formal word used in announcements.
Whole, all, before a noun: 全班 "the whole class", 全家, 全国, 全年. It can also be an adverb, "completely": 全对 "all correct".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Quán bān tóngxué dōu lái le.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: The whole country, with 全 and 国. 全国各地 "all over the country".
What color do you like?: It is snowing all over the country.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: A tiny bit: 一点 doubled. 我会说一点点 "I can speak a very little". It softens or reduces: 只有一点点.
What color do you like?: I can only speak a tiny bit.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: All, every: 所有的人 "everyone". It is followed by a noun and often by 都: 所有的人都笑了.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Suǒyǒu de rén dōu xiào le.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Among them, including: 其中一个 "one of them". 其 here means "that, their", and 中 "in". It refers back to a group you have just named.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 我有三只猫，其中一只是白色的。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 我有三隻貓，其中一隻是白色的。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ yǒu sān zhī māo, qízhōng yī zhī shì báisè de.
What color do you like?: I have three cats, and one of them is white.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Other, others: 其他人 "the other people", 其他的 "the rest". It is for things and people left out of the group already mentioned. 其 plus 他.
Almost, about the same: 我们差不多大 "we are about the same age". As an answer to "how is it?", it means "so-so, about right". 差 is read chà here. Said chàbuduō.
What color do you like?: We are about the same age.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Basketball: 篮 ("basket") plus 球 ("ball"). 打篮球 "play basketball". 篮 has 竹 ("bamboo") on top.
Volleyball: 排 ("row") plus 球. 打排球 "play volleyball". With a hand ball sport you use 打.
Tennis: 网 ("net") plus 球. 打网球 "play tennis". The traditional form is 網球, with 糹 on the left of 網. Many ball sports take 打.
Court, field for ball games: 球 ("ball") plus 场 ("field"). 球场上 "on the court".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Qiúchǎng shang yǒu hěn duō rén.
What color do you like?: There are many people on the court.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Team in a ball game: 球 ("ball") plus 队 ("team"). 球队的队长 "the team's captain".
Sports shoes, sneakers: 球 plus 鞋. They are shoes for sports. Measure word: 双. 穿球鞋 "wear sneakers".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng mǎi yī shuāng qiúxié.
What color do you like?: I want to buy a pair of sneakers.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Team captain: 队 ("team") plus 长 ("head"), read zhǎng. The same pattern is in 班长 and 组长.
Stand in line, queue: a verb and its object, 排 ("arrange") plus 队 ("line"). 请排队 is what staff say.
Exercise, sport, and "to exercise": 多运动 "get more exercise". 运动员 is an athlete.
Activity, event: 一个活动 "an event". 参加活动 "take part in an event". It can also mean "to move about, stretch": 活动活动.
Take part in, join: 参加比赛 "take part in a match", 参加会议 "attend a meeting". What you join is an event or a group. 参 here is read cān.
What color do you like?: Are you taking part in this event?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Hold an event, formal: 比赛在明天举行 "the match takes place tomorrow". 举 ("lift") plus 行 ("carry out").
What color do you like?: The match will be held tomorrow.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Raise, lift, and "cite": 举手 "raise a hand", 举例子 "give an example". The thing raised follows: 他举起了手. 举 is 舉 in traditional script, with 手 as part of it.
Novel, fiction: 看小说 "read novels", 写小说 "write a novel". 小 ("small") plus 说 ("talk"), a "minor talk".
Story: 讲故事 "tell a story". The 事 is light: gùshi.
What color do you like?: He tells the child a story.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Joke: 讲笑话 "tell a joke". 笑话 can also be a verb, "to laugh at someone": 别笑话我. The 话 is light: xiàohua.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā jiǎng le yī ge xiàohua.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Joke with the spoken ending 儿: xiàohuar. 讲笑话儿 or 说笑话儿 "tell a joke". It is the same as 笑话.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ tīng guo zhège xiàohuar ma?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Program, show on television, radio or on stage: 电视节目 "TV program". 节目 can also be an item of a show.
Film, movie: 影 ("shadow, image") plus 片 ("film"). It is more formal than 电影 and fits a particular film. 看影片 "watch a film".
Music: 音 ("sound") plus 乐. Here 乐 is read yuè, as against lè in 快乐. 听音乐 "listen to music".
Concert: 音乐 plus 会 ("gathering"). 听音乐会 "go to a concert". Counted with 场: 一场音乐会.
Photo: 照 ("shine, picture") plus 片. 一张照片 "a photo". 照片 is the picture itself. The act of taking it is 照相 or 拍照.
Take a photo: a verb and its object, 照 plus 相 ("picture"). 照相 splits: 照了一张相. 拍照 means about the same. 相 here is read xiàng.
Draw, paint, and "a picture": 画画 "draw". 画家 is "painter".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā huà le yī zhī māo.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Picture, painting with the spoken ending 儿: 一张画儿. It sounds colloquial.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Qiáng shang yǒu yī zhāng huàr.
What color do you like?: There is a painting on the wall.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Painter: 画 plus 家 ("expert"). The 家 ending names a skilled person: 作家 "writer", 画家, 科学家.
Writer, author: 作 ("write, make") plus 家. The ending 家 names a person skilled in a field, as in 画家. 当作家 "become a writer".
What color do you like?: She wants to become a writer.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Picture, image, often one on a screen: 图片 plus a measure like 张. It is the word for pictures in a document or website. Compare 照片 for photos.
Letter, and "trust, believe": 写信 "write a letter", 信他 "believe him". 信 as a verb is used for believing a person or his words: 我不信他的话. Counted with 封.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ bù xìn tā de huà.
What color do you like?: I don't believe what he says.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Text message: 短 ("short") plus 信 ("message"). 发短信 "send a text". Measure word: 条.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ gěi nǐ fā le yī tiáo duǎnxìn.
What color do you like?: I sent you a text message.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Information, message: 收到信息 "get a message". It covers data and also messages in an app.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ shōudào le tā de xìnxī.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Signal: 手机没有信号 "no signal on the phone". 信 plus 号 ("number, mark"). 号 here is read hào.
Newspaper: 报 ("report") plus 纸 ("paper"). 看报纸 "read the newspaper". Measure word: 份 or 张.
Daily newspaper: 日 ("day") plus 报. It is often part of a newspaper's name.
Evening paper: 晚 ("evening") plus 报. It comes out in the evening.
What color do you like?: Grandpa likes reading the evening paper.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: News: 看新闻 "watch the news". 新 ("new") plus 闻 ("hear, news"). 新闻 is the news of the media. A single item is 一条新闻.
What color do you like?: I watch the news every day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Advertisement: 广 ("wide") plus 告 ("announce"). 电视广告 is a TV advertisement.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Diànshì shang yǒu hěn duō guǎnggào.
What color do you like?: There are many ads on TV.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: List of names: 名 ("name") plus 单 ("list"). 在名单上 "on the list".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ de míngzi zài míngdān shang.
What color do you like?: My name is on the list.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Name of a thing, an organization or a place: 名称. It is more formal than 名字, which is used for people and things alike.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhège diàn de míngchēng shì shénme?
What color do you like?: What is the name of this shop?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Star in the sense of a famous person: 明星, 电影明星 "film star". 明 ("bright") plus 星 ("star"). The star in the sky is 星星.
Net, web and the internet: 上网 "go online", 网上 "on the internet". 网 began as a picture of a fishing net. The traditional 網 adds 糹 ("thread").
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ zài wǎng shang mǎi dōngxi.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Website: 网 ("net") plus 站 ("station"). 这个网站 "this website". 站 means "stop, station", and here it is a "site".
Switch off, shut down a phone or computer: 关 ("close") plus 机 ("machine"). Its opposite is 开机. 请把手机关机 is a common request.
Switch on, boot up: 开 ("open") plus 机 ("machine"). The opposite is 关机. 电脑开机 "the computer starts".
What color do you like?: The computer is slow to start up.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Healthy, health: 身体健康 "good health", often used in wishes. As an adjective: 健康的生活.
Medicine: 吃药 "take medicine". 药 is 藥 in traditional script, which has 樂 where the simplified form has 约. 药 has 艹 ("plant") on top.
Pharmacy, drugstore: 药 ("medicine") plus 店 ("shop"). 去药店买药 "go to the pharmacy to buy medicine". Measure word: 家.
What color do you like?: The pharmacy is open in the evening too.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Pill, tablet: 药 ("medicine") plus 片 ("flat piece"). 一片药片 or 两片 "two pills". 药片 is solid and flat, as against 药水.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè zhǒng yàopiàn yī tiān chī liǎng cì.
What color do you like?: Take this pill twice a day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Liquid medicine: 药 ("medicine") plus 水 ("water"), as against 药片. Cough syrup is a typical case. 喝药水 "drink liquid medicine".
What color do you like?: The child drank the liquid medicine.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Western medicine, and the doctor who practices it: 西 ("west") plus 医 ("medicine"). The opposite is 中医. 看西医 is "see a Western-style doctor".
What color do you like?: I want to see a Western-medicine doctor.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Traditional Chinese medicine, and its doctor: 中 ("Chinese") plus 医. 看中医 "see a TCM doctor". It is the opposite of 西医.
What color do you like?: He is seeing a TCM doctor.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Be admitted to hospital: 住 ("stay") plus 院 ("hospital"), a verb and its object. 他住院了 "he is in hospital". Opposite: 出院.
What color do you like?: He fell ill and is in hospital.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Leave hospital, be discharged: 出 ("out") plus 院. The opposite of 住院. 明天可以出院 "can go home tomorrow".
What color do you like?: He can leave the hospital tomorrow.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Check, examine: 检查身体 "have a physical". 检查作业 "check homework". 检 has 木 ("wood") on the left.
What color do you like?: The doctor gives me a check-up.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Look up, check: 查词典 "look in a dictionary", 查一下 "check quickly". Compare 检查, which examines a thing carefully.
Safe, safety: 注意安全 "mind your safety". 这里很安全 "it's safe here". 安 ("peaceful") plus 全 ("whole").
Safe and sound, peaceful: 平安到家 "arrive home safely". 平 ("level") plus 安 ("safe"). The apostrophe is in pinyin because 安 begins with a vowel: píng'ān. It is also used in wishes such as 一路平安.
What color do you like?: We got home safe and sound.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Help, assistance: a verb (帮助别人) and a noun (谢谢你的帮助). More formal than 帮忙.
Look after, take care of: 照顾孩子 "look after a child", 照顾病人 "care for a patient". The 顾 is light: zhàogu.
What color do you like?: She looks after the child at home.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Pretty, beautiful: 漂亮 is for people, clothes and things. It can also mean "well done", as in 干得漂亮. The 亮 is light: piàoliang. 漂 is read piào here, and piāo in "to float".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā de xīn yīfu hěn piàoliang.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Low: 气温很低 "the temperature is low". The opposite is 高. For a person's height use 矮.
Short, for length and time: 头发很短 "short hair", 时间很短 "a short time". The opposite is 长. For a person's height use 矮.
Light in weight, and "gentle": 这个包很轻. The opposite is 重. 轻轻地 is "softly". 轻 is 輕 in traditional script, which has 車 on the left.
Bright: 灯很亮 "the light is bright". 天亮了 "it's daylight". It is also in 漂亮 and 月亮.
What color do you like?: It is light, time to get up.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Near, close: 离学校很近 "close to the school". Use it with 离: A 离 B 很近. The opposite is 远. 近 is read jìn.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jiā lí xuéxiào hěn jìn.
What color do you like?: My home is close to the school.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Flat, level: 这条路很平 "this road is flat". It also means "calm" and "equal": 平等.
Full: 车上坐满了人 "the bus is full of people". 满 + 了 follows a verb: 坐满, 装满. Compare 饱, which is "full" from eating. 满 has 氵 ("water").
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Chē shang zuò mǎn le rén.
What color do you like?: The bus is full of people.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Quiet: 请安静 "please be quiet". 安 ("peaceful") plus 静 ("still").
What color do you like?: Please be quiet for a moment.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Convenient: 很方便 "very convenient". It goes with transport and shops: 交通很方便. 方便 can also be a polite way to say "go to the toilet". 方便面 is instant noodles.
What color do you like?: It is very convenient to live here.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Not bad, pretty good: 不 plus 错 ("wrong"). It is a modest compliment: 这个菜不错. The tone of 不 is bù in dictionaries.
Clear, and "to know clearly": 听不清楚 "can't hear clearly", 我不清楚 "I'm not sure". The 楚 is light: qīngchu.
Ordinary, common: 普通人 "an ordinary person". It also appears in 普通话.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā shì yī ge pǔtōng rén.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Ordinary, and "usually, normally": 我平常不喝咖啡 "I normally don't drink coffee". As an adverb it goes before the verb. 平 plus 常 ("often"). Compare 平时.
Size: 大小 ("big and small") as one noun, as in 大小合适 "the size fits". Two opposites together give a noun for the quality, as in 多少.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè liǎng shuāng xié dàxiǎo yīyàng.
What color do you like?: These two pairs of shoes are the same size.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Loudly: 大声 ("big sound") before the verb: 大声说话 "speak loudly". The opposite is 小声. 请大声一点 asks someone to speak up.
Quietly, in a low voice: 小声 before the verb: 小声说话 "speak softly". The opposite is 大声.
Sound, voice: 声 ("sound") plus 音 ("sound"). 他的声音很好听 "his voice is nice".
Sound, ring, be loud: 电话响了 "the phone rang". It is also an adjective, "loud". 响 has 口 ("mouth") on the left.
Shout, call out: 喊你 "call you". 喊 can be to call a person from afar: 喊他一声. Compare 叫, which is more general.
What color do you like?: He is calling you at the door.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Fake, false, read jiǎ: 假的 "a fake". In 假期 "holiday" it is read jià. The opposite of 假 "fake" is 真.
Flow: 河水向东流 "the river flows east". 氵 ("water") is on the left.
Popular, fashionable: 流 ("flow") plus 行 ("go"). 这首歌很流行 "this song is popular".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shǒu gē xiànzài hěn liúxíng.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Even more: 今天比昨天更冷 "today is even colder than yesterday". 更 + adjective. It goes with 比 comparisons and also stands alone: 更好. Read gèng here. In 更新 it is read gēng.
What color do you like?: Today is even colder than yesterday.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Quite, rather, spoken: 挺好的 "quite good". The pattern is 挺 + adjective + 的, with 的 often at the end. It is informal.
Pretty good, quite fine: 挺 ("quite") plus 好. As a reply to "how is it?": 挺好 "pretty good". Add 的 for a warm tone: 挺好的.
Especially, particularly: 特别冷 "especially cold". It goes before an adjective. It also means "special": 特别的礼物. 特 plus 别.
Very, extremely, written and formal: 十分高兴 "very happy". It goes before an adjective or a verb of feeling. Literally "ten parts out of ten".
Really, truly: 实在太累了 "I'm really too tired". It goes before the adjective or verb and is stronger than 真. As an adjective it means "honest, solid".
Actual, real: 实际情况 "the actual situation", and 实际上 "in fact, actually".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā shíjì shang bù huì kāichē.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Completely, entirely: 完全同意 "completely agree". It goes before the verb.
Greatly: 大 doubled to give an adverb before the verb: 大大提高 "greatly improve". It comes before a verb of change.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā de Hànyǔ dàdà tígāo le.
What color do you like?: His Chinese has improved a great deal.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: How…! in exclamations: 多么好看啊！ "how beautiful!" It goes before an adjective, usually with 啊 at the end.
So, this much, for something near: 这么大 "this big", 这么早 "so early". It goes before an adjective or verb.
So, that much, for something far or earlier: 那么多 "that many". At the start of a clause it means "in that case": 那么我们走吧.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nàme duō rén, wǒ bù xiǎng qù.
What color do you like?: With that many people, I don't want to go.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: The more… the more…: 越…越… in a pair. 越吃越多 "the more you eat, the more it is". The pattern joins two verbs or adjectives: 雨越下越大 "the rain gets heavier and heavier". 越 alone only appears in this pattern, most often as 越来越 "more and more" before an adjective: 天气越来越冷.
What color do you like?: The rain gets heavier and heavier.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: More and more: 越来越 + adjective or verb, with 了 at the end: 越来越冷了 "colder and colder". It shows a change that goes on.
What color do you like?: The weather is getting colder and colder.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: A bit, somewhat: 有点儿冷 "a bit cold". It goes before an adjective and is often used for a complaint or something unwanted. After the adjective use 一点儿: 冷一点儿. Said diǎnr.
What color do you like?: It is a bit cold today.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: A bit, the longer form of 有点儿, with 一 inserted. The two mean the same. It goes before an adjective: 有一点儿累. After the adjective, 一点儿 stands alone.
Anew, start again: 重新开始 "start over". 重 is read chóng here, "again", not zhòng "heavy". It goes before the verb. 重新 + verb means doing something over.
Repeat: 请重复一遍 "please repeat". 重 is read chóng. 复 means "again". The traditional form is 重複, with 複, not 復.
A long time: 好久不见 "long time no see". 好 here intensifies it. 好久 comes after the verb as a duration: 等了好久 "waited a long time".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Hǎojiǔ bù jiàn, nǐ hǎo ma?
What color do you like?: Long time no see, how are you?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: How long: the question for duration. It goes after the verb: 学了多久 "studied for how long".
What color do you like?: How long have you studied Chinese?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Soon, before long: 不久就 + verb. 不久以前 "not long ago". It goes before the verb.
After a moment, soon: 一会儿 negated, "not even a moment". Often followed by 就: 不一会儿，他就来了.
Just (a moment ago): 我刚到家 "I just got home". It goes before the verb. It cannot start the sentence as 刚才 can. 刚 also means "exactly" in 刚好.
Just now: 刚才 is a time word, so it can start the sentence or follow the subject. 刚才谁给你打电话？ is a natural question.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Gāngcái shéi gěi nǐ dǎ diànhuà?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Just, doubled from 刚, and used in the same way before a verb. 他刚刚走 "he has just left". The second 刚 is light: gānggang.
Long ago, a long time already: 早 ("early") plus 就. 我早就知道了 "I have known it for ages". It shows that something is earlier than expected.
Already: 已经 + verb + 了. 我已经吃过了 "I have already eaten". It goes before the verb. 已 differs from 己 (jǐ) only in how the last stroke ends.
Often, frequently: 经常去 "go often". It goes before the verb.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jīngcháng qù nà jiā diàn.
What color do you like?: I often go to that shop.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: At any time, whenever: 随时 + verb. 你可以随时来 "you can come any time". It goes before the verb.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Yǒu wèntí kěyǐ suíshí wèn wǒ.
What color do you like?: If you have a question, ask me any time.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Straight on, "continuously" and "all along": 一直走 "go straight", 一直往前走; 昨天夜里一直下雨 "it rained all last night"; 我一直喜欢中国文化 "I have always liked Chinese culture".
Forever, always: 我永远爱你 "I will always love you". 永 began as a picture of a long river.
Always, with a complaint: 老是迟到 "always late". The 是 is light: lǎoshi.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā lǎoshi wàng le dài shǒujī.
What color do you like?: He always forgets to bring his phone.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Again, for a repeat that has already happened: 他昨天又来了 "he came again yesterday". For a repeat in the future, use 再. 又 usually comes with 了, and 再 does not. It can show annoyance: 你又迟到了 "you're late again!" It can also mean "also", as in 又大又好 "both big and good".

Only then, not until: 他十点才起床 "he doesn't get up until ten". It points to something late or less than expected. 就 shows early or easy, and 才 shows late or hard. 就 usually comes with 了, and 才 does not: 他八点才来. It goes before the verb.
What color do you like?: He doesn't get up until ten.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Suddenly: 天忽然下雨了 "it suddenly rained". It goes before the verb.
Recently, lately: 最近你忙吗？ It can start a sentence or follow the subject.
About to: 快要…了, as in 火车快要开了. It cannot be used with a specific time word. For that use 就要. In speech it is common for being close to a limit: 我快要饿死了 "I'm starving".
What color do you like?: The train is about to leave.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: About to, and it can be used with a specific time: 我们明天就要走了 "we leave tomorrow". 就要…了 is the form that works with a time word: 我下个星期就要回国了. It also sounds more urgent than 快要.
Hurry up: 快点儿! The 点儿 is a small amount, so literally "a bit faster". It also follows a verb: 走快点儿.
Common, often seen: 常见的鸟 "a common bird". 常 ("often") plus 见 ("see").
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shì yī zhǒng chángjiàn de niǎo.
What color do you like?: This is a common kind of bird.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Commonly used: 常用字 "common characters". 常 ("often") plus 用 ("use").
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shì yī ge chángyòng de cí.
What color do you like?: This is a commonly used word.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Can, may: permission or possibility. 我可以进来吗？ asks permission. It can also mean "not bad": 还可以. Its negative is 不可以 for "not allowed".
Maybe, possible: 他可能不来 "he may not come". It is an adverb (可能不来), and 有可能 means "it is possible".
Be able to, a bit more formal than 能: 能够看懂 "be able to understand". 能够 stresses having the means or the chance.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ nénggòu kàn dǒng zhè běn shū.
What color do you like?: I am able to understand this book.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Should, ought to: 你应该多休息 "you should rest more". Its negative is 不应该. 应 is read yīng here.
Should, and "it is one's turn": 该你了 "it's your turn". 该 is shorter than 应该: 该走了 "it's time to go".
Must, have to: 你必须来 "you must come". Its negative is 不必 or 不用 "need not", not 不必须.
Definitely, must: 明天我一定来 "I will definitely come tomorrow". It goes before the verb, and 一 here is read yī in dictionaries, though people say yí before 定.
Not necessarily: 贵的不一定好 "expensive doesn't mean good".
Perhaps: 也许他还在睡觉 "perhaps he is still sleeping". It can start a sentence.
Can only, have no choice but: 我只能等 "I can only wait".
Not OK, won't do: 这样不行 "this won't do". It can also mean "not working". 行 is read xíng. The positive answer is 行.
Don't…, and "do not want": 不要说话 "don't talk". 不要 is also "I don't want it": 我不要.
Not as good as, and "had better": A 不如 B means "A is not as good as B". 走路不如骑车快 "walking is slower than cycling".
What color do you like?: Walking is not as fast as cycling.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Not very: 我不太饿 "I'm not very hungry". It goes before an adjective and softens the denial. 不太好 is a polite way to say "not good".
On purpose, deliberately: 他不是故意的 "he didn't mean to". 故意 + verb: 故意迟到.
What color do you like?: He didn't do it on purpose.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Take out: 拿 ("take") plus 出 ("out"). 拿出一本书 "take out a book".
Get, receive something in hand: 拿到 plus a result: 拿到钱, 拿到手机.
Obtain, achieve: 取得成绩 "achieve results". It is used for abstract things such as results and success.
Receive, pick up, connect: 接电话 "answer the phone", 接人 "pick someone up".
What color do you like?: I'm going to the airport to pick up a friend.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Receive, for calls and letters: 接到电话 "get a call". Compare 收到.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ jiēdào le tā de diànhuà.
What color do you like?: I received a call from him.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Accept: 接受礼物, 接受意见 "accept advice". It can also mean "undergo": 接受检查.
Receive, something that comes to you: 收到信, 收到礼物. 收 ("take in") plus 到. It is used for mail, messages and gifts.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ shōudào wǒ de duǎnxìn le ma?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Deliver to: 送 ("send") plus 到. 送到我家 "deliver to my home".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Qǐng bǎ tā sòng dào wǒ jiā.
What color do you like?: Please deliver it to my home.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Give as a present: 送 ("give") plus 给 ("to"). 这个送给你 "this is a gift for you". The receiver follows.
Hand in, hand over, pay: 交作业 "hand in homework", 交钱 "pay money", 交朋友 "make friends".
Hand over to: 交给老师 "hand it to the teacher". 把 often comes before: 把作业交给老师.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Qǐng bǎ zuòyè jiāo gěi lǎoshī.
What color do you like?: Please hand your homework to the teacher.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Raise, bring up, and "carry in the hand": 提问题 "ask a question", 提意见 "make a suggestion", 提前 "in advance". 扌 ("hand") is the meaning part. In daily speech the object is something said or put forward.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎng tí yī ge wèntí.
What color do you like?: I want to raise a question.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Put forward a question, suggestion or demand: 提 ("raise") plus 出 ("out"). 提出意见 "make a suggestion". The thing put forward is abstract.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā tíchū le yī ge hǎo yìjiàn.
What color do you like?: He put forward a good suggestion.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Mention, refer to: 提 plus 到. 他提到了你 "he mentioned you". It goes with a person or a topic.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā tídào le nǐ de míngzi.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Stay, and "keep, leave behind": 留在家里 "stay at home", 留言 "leave a message". 请留一点给我 "leave a little for me".
What color do you like?: Please leave a little for me.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Leave behind, and "stay behind": 留下一封信 "leave a letter". It also means to stay while others go: 你留下来.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā liúxià le yī fēng xìn.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Add: 加水 "add water", 加油 "add fuel", 3 加 2 "3 plus 2".
What color do you like?: Please add a little more water.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Change, become different: 天气变了 "the weather has changed". A new state follows: 变冷了 "turned cold".
Turn into, become: 变 ("change") plus 成 ("become"). 变成 + noun: 变成大人 "turn into an adult".
What color do you like?: The child has become an adult.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Become, and "succeed, complete". 他成了我的朋友 "he became my friend". 成 is in 成为, 完成, 成功 and 成绩. 成 can also mean "OK": 成！
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā chéng le wǒ de péngyou.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Become: 成 ("become") plus 为 ("be"). The formal word: 成为医生 "become a doctor". It is more formal than 变成.
What color do you like?: He wants to become a doctor.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Change, correct: 改作业 "mark homework", 改错 "correct a mistake".
Change, alter: 改 ("change") plus 变 ("change"). 他的想法改变了 "his thinking has changed". It can take an object: 改变生活.
Do, make, handle, a loose verb for many actions: 弄坏 "break", 弄脏 "make dirty", 弄好 "get it done". It stands in for a more exact verb. Often with 把.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ bǎ shǒujī nòng huài le.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Fall, drop: 掉在地上 "fall on the floor", and as a result after a verb: 丢掉 "throw away", 忘掉 "forget".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā de shǒujī diào zài dì shang le.
What color do you like?: His phone fell on the floor.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Fall over, topple, read dǎo: 树倒了 "the tree fell". With the other reading, dào, it means "pour" (倒水) and "reverse".

Send out, issue, and "emit": 发短信 "send a text", 发烧 "have a fever". In 头发 it is another word, "hair", written 髮 in traditional script. 发 stands for 發 (send) and 髮 (hair) in simplified writing. Read fā.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ gěi tā fā le yī ge xìnxī.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Discover, find out, notice: 发现 + clause: 我发现他不在家 "I found that he wasn't at home". It is about noticing something that was already there.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ fāxiàn tā bù zài jiā.
What color do you like?: I found that he wasn't at home.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Appear, come into sight: 出现 plus a person or thing that was not there. 门口出现了一个人 "someone appeared at the door".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Ménkǒu chūxiàn le yī ge rén.
What color do you like?: A person appeared at the door.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Raise, improve: 提高水平 "raise the level". 提 ("lift") plus 高 ("high"). It is used for things that go up: level, skill, price.
What color do you like?: I want to improve my Chinese level.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Finish, end, and as a result after a verb: 吃完 "finish eating", 写完 "finish writing". The pattern is verb + 完.
Find out and pick out: 找 ("look for") plus 出. 找出错的地方 "find where it is wrong".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā zhǎochū le cuò de dìfang.
What color do you like?: He found where it was wrong.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Arrive at, come to a result, such as a conclusion: 得出结论 "reach a conclusion". 得 ("get") plus 出.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒmen déchū le yī ge jiélùn.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Accomplish, manage to do: 做 plus 到. 说到做到 "do what you say".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ shuō dào jiù yào zuòdào.
What color do you like?: If you say it, you must do it.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: See, meet with a result: 见 plus 到. 见到你 "see you, meet you". 看见 means about the same.
Have seen, have met: 见 plus the experience marker 过. 我见过他 "I have met him". The 过 is light.
Bump into, touch: 别碰 "don't touch". 碰 can also mean "meet by chance".
Run into by chance, or "bump": 碰到老师 "run into the teacher".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ zài lùshang pèngdào le lǎoshī.
What color do you like?: I ran into my teacher on the road.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Run into, with 见 ("see"), a chance meeting: 碰见朋友. It is about meeting someone unexpectedly.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ pèngjiàn le yī ge péngyou.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Receive, be given: 受到欢迎 "be welcomed", 受到帮助 "be helped". 受 ("receive") plus 到.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā shòudào le dàjiā de huānyíng.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Realize, achieve a plan or a dream: 梦想实现了 "the dream came true". 实 ("real") plus 现 ("appear"): to become real.
Take up, occupy: 占座位 "take a seat", 占时间 "take up time". It also means "account for", as in 占百分之十 "make up ten percent". Read zhàn. In traditional script it is written 佔.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā zhàn le wǒ de zuòwèi.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Company, firm: 他在一家公司工作 "he works at a company". The measure word is 家.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā zài yī jiā gōngsī gōngzuò.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Office: 办公 ("do official work") plus 室 ("room"). 在办公室 "in the office".
What color do you like?: The teacher is in the office.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Work unit, organization, where one works: 你在哪个单位工作？ It is also a unit of measure: 长度单位.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ zài nǎ ge dānwèi gōngzuò?
What color do you like?: Which organization do you work for?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Do casual work, work part-time: 打 ("do") plus 工 ("work"), a verb and its object. It is work done for pay, often a short job. 他在饭馆打工 "he works at a restaurant".
What color do you like?: He works part-time at a restaurant.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Do work, labor: 干 is read gàn here, "do". In traditional script the word is 幹活兒, with 幹 for "do". The 儿 is the ending: gànhuór.
Discuss, talk over: 我们商量一下 "let's talk it over". The 量 is light: shāngliang.
Plan, noun and verb: 有计划 "have a plan", 计划去 "plan to go".
What color do you like?: What plans do you have this year?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Handle, do, manage: 办事 "do an errand", 办护照 "apply for a passport".
What color do you like?: I'm going to apply for a passport.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Make an effort, work hard: 努力学习 "study hard". As an adjective: 他很努力.
Discuss: 我们讨论了这个问题 "we discussed this problem".
Notify, notice: 通知我们 "inform us" and a noun 通知 "a notice".
你喜欢什么颜色？: 老师通知我们明天考试。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 老師通知我們明天考試。
What color do you like?: The teacher told us there is an exam tomorrow.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Demand, require, and "requirement": 要求我们 "ask us to". As a noun: 有要求 "have requirements".
你喜欢什么颜色？: 老师要求我们每天练习。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 老師要求我們每天練習。
What color do you like?: The teacher requires us to practice every day.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Complete, finish: 完成作业 "finish homework".
What color do you like?: I have already finished my homework.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Carry out, conduct: 比赛正在进行 "the match is in progress". Formal. 进行 takes a noun that names an action: 进行讨论 "hold a discussion".
Use, the formal word: 使用电脑 "use a computer". 使 ("make") plus 用. It is close to 用, but suits writing and instructions.
Choose, select: 你选哪一个？ Related: 选择.
Action, act: 马上行动 "act at once".
What color do you like?: We have to act at once.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Behavior, conduct: 好的行为 "good behavior".
Correct, right: 正确的答案 "the correct answer". It is formal. The opposite is 错误.
Accurate, precise: 时间很准确 "the time is accurate". 准 is read zhǔn. 准确 is about exactness, and 正确 about being right. In traditional script, 准 is written 準: 準確.
Normal: 一切正常 "everything is normal". The opposite is 不正常.
Just right, and "happen to": 大小正好 "just the right size". As an adverb: 我正好在家 "I happened to be at home".
What color do you like?: This piece of clothing is just the right size.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Is precisely: 这正是我想要的 "this is just what I wanted". 正是 + noun phrase.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè zhèngshì wǒ xiǎng yào de.
What color do you like?: This is exactly what I wanted.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Real, genuine, and "truly": 真正的朋友 "a true friend". It goes before the noun with 的: 真正的原因 "the real reason".
Fluent: 她的英语很流利 "her English is fluent". It describes speaking or writing.
Smooth, without trouble: 一切顺利 "everything goes well". It is a common wish: 祝你工作顺利.
What color do you like?: I wish your work goes smoothly.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Fair, just: 公平 ("public" plus "level"). 这样不公平 "this isn't fair".
Equal, equality: 平等 ("level" plus "equal"). 男女平等 "equality of men and women".
What color do you like?: Men and women should be equal.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Free, freedom: 我想要自由 "I want freedom". As an adjective: 很自由 "very free".
Different: 不 plus 同 ("same"). 和…不同 "different from…". 不同的人 "different people". The opposite is 相同.
The same, identical: 相 ("each other") plus 同. 相同的 "the same". The opposite is 不同.
Ordinary, average, and "generally": 一般来说 "generally speaking". As an adverb it goes before the verb: 我一般七点起床 "I usually get up at seven".
What color do you like?: I usually get up at seven.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Suitable, fitting: 这双鞋很合适 "these shoes fit".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shuāng xié wǒ chuān hěn héshì.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Direct, directly: 直接问他 "ask him directly". It goes before the verb. The opposite is 间接.
As you like, casual: 请随便坐 "sit wherever you like". It means any choice is fine: 随便吃 "eat whatever". As a reply to "what do you want to eat?" it means "anything is OK".
Think, consider: 我认为… "I think that…". It is more formal and firm than 觉得, and it gives an opinion after thought. 认为 + clause.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ rènwéi tā shì duì de.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Think wrongly: 我以为你不来了 "I thought you weren't coming" (and you did). It points to a belief that turned out to be false. 以为 and 认为 look alike, but 以为 is used for mistaken ideas.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ yǐwéi nǐ bù lái le.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Believe, trust: 我相信你 "I trust you". 相信 + person or statement: 相信他的话. 相 here is read xiāng, "each other".
Think of, come to mind: 想 plus 到. 我没想到 "I didn't expect it". 没想到… often starts a clause that shows surprise.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ méi xiǎngdào nǐ huì lái.
What color do you like?: I didn't think you would come.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Recall, remember: 想 plus 起. 想起他的名字 "remember his name". With 来 it is 想起来.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ xiǎngqǐ tā de míngzi le.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Idea, way of thinking: 你有什么想法？ "what do you think?" It is a personal thought.
View, opinion: 你对这件事有什么看法？ The pattern is 对 + thing + 的看法. Close to 想法, but it is about an issue.
你喜欢什么颜色？: 你对这件事有什么看法？
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 你對這件事有什麼看法？
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ duì zhè jiàn shì yǒu shénme kànfǎ?
What color do you like?: What is your view on this matter?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Point of view, opinion: 观点 plus a person: 他的观点. 同意他的观点 "agree with his view".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ bù tóngyì tā de guāndiǎn.
What color do you like?: I don't agree with his view.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Ideal, dream for the future: 我的理想是当老师 "my dream is to become a teacher". It can also be an adjective, "ideal": 很理想.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ de lǐxiǎng shì dāng lǎoshī.
What color do you like?: My dream is to become a teacher.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Understand: 懂了 "I get it". After a verb it is the result: 听懂 "understand by hearing", 看懂 "understand by reading". 听不懂 "can't understand".
Understand, know how, a bit more formal and about principles: 懂得道理 "understand how things are". The 得 is light: dǒngde.
Habit, and "be used to": 习惯早起 "be used to getting up early". 我不习惯 "I am not used to it".
你喜欢什么颜色？: 我还不习惯这里的天气。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 我還不習慣這裡的天氣。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ hái bù xíguàn zhèlǐ de tiānqì.
What color do you like?: I'm not yet used to the weather here.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Plan, intend: 你打算去哪儿？ 打算 + verb. It is less formal than 计划. 我打算… "I plan to…".
What color do you like?: Where do you plan to go?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Count, "calculate", and "count as": 这个不算贵 "this doesn't count as expensive". 算 also means "to settle a matter": 算了 "forget it".
Attitude: 他的态度很好 "his attitude is good". The 度 is light: tàidu.
Call, name: 称他为老师 "call him teacher". The pattern is 称 + A + 为 + B. It is also "to weigh".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Dàjiā dōu chēng tā wéi lǎoshī.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Be called, be known as: 这种鱼叫作什么？ "What is this fish called?" 叫做 is another way to write it.
What color do you like?: What is this kind of fish called?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Attach importance to, value: 重视教育 "value education". 重 is read zhòng here.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒmen hěn zhòngshì zhè jiàn shì.
What color do you like?: We take this matter very seriously.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Way, means to deal with something: 想办法 "think of a way", 没办法 "nothing can be done".
What color do you like?: Let's think of a way together.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Method: 学习方法 "study method". It names a systematic way of doing something. Compare 办法, which is a way out of a problem.
Way of doing something, practice: 他的做法不对 "his way of doing it is wrong". It judges what a person did.
What color do you like?: His way of doing it is wrong.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Aspect, side: 在…方面 "in terms of…". 在学习方面 "in terms of study". It marks the area being talked about.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā zài xuéxí fāngmiàn hěn nǔlì.
What color do you like?: He works hard in his studies.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Reason, cause: 迟到的原因 "the reason for being late".
What color do you like?: What is the reason for being late?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: So it was!, on finding out the truth: 原来是你 "so it's you". It also means "originally": 原来的名字 "the original name".
Result, outcome: 考试的结果 "the result of the exam". As a conjunction it means "in the end": 结果他没来.
Purpose, aim: 你来的目的是什么？ "What is your purpose in coming?" It is the goal behind an action.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Nǐ lái de mùdì shì shénme?
What color do you like?: What is the purpose of your coming?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Reason, sense, principle: 有道理 "makes sense", 讲道理 "be reasonable". 你说得有道理 "what you say is right". The 理 is light: dàoli.
Characteristic, feature: 这个城市的特点 "the features of this city".
What color do you like?: What are the features of this city?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Condition, requirement: 条件很好 "conditions are good", 有条件 "have the means". It covers both circumstances and terms.
What color do you like?: The conditions here are very good.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Chance, opportunity: 好机会 "a good opportunity". 有机会 "if there is a chance". 机 here is not "machine".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè shì yī ge hǎo jīhuì.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Effect, function: 起作用 "take effect", 有作用 "be effective". It names what something does.
Key point, emphasis: Read zhòngdiǎn here. 这是重点 "this is the key point". 重点 can also be an adverb: 重点学习.
Main, chief: 主要原因 "the main reason". It is also an adverb: 主要是… "mainly…".
Center: 城市中心 "the city center". Also in names of places: 购物中心 "shopping center".
What color do you like?: The school is in the city center.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Question, problem: 有问题吗？ "any questions?" 问题 can be a question you ask or a problem with something: 没问题 "no problem".
Matter, affair, thing: 很多事情 "many things". The 情 is light: shìqing. It is broader than 事.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ yǒu hěn duō shìqing yào zuò.
What color do you like?: I have many things to do.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: A good thing: 好 plus 事. 这是一件好事 "this is a good thing".
Benefit, advantage: 对…有好处 "be good for…". 多运动对身体有好处. The opposite is 坏处. The 处 is light: hǎochu.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Duō yùndòng duì shēntǐ yǒu hǎochu.
What color do you like?: Exercising more is good for your health.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Harm, disadvantage: 对…有坏处 "be bad for…". The opposite is 好处. The 处 is light: huàichu.
What color do you like?: What harm is there in doing it this way?

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Angle, point of view: 从这个角度看 "seen from this angle". 角 is read jiǎo, not jué.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Cóng zhège jiǎodù kàn hěn piàoliang.
What color do you like?: It looks pretty from this angle.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Influence, affect: 影响学习 "affect study". As a noun: 有影响 "have an influence".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tiānqì yǐngxiǎng le wǒ de xīnqíng.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Here 得 is read dé: "get, obtain, win". 得到 "receive", 取得 and 得出 use it. 得分 is "score a point". 得了第一名 "came first". The other 得 is the light particle in 跑得快.
A light particle linking a verb to how it goes: 说得很好 "speaks well", 跑得很快 "runs fast". The verb comes first and the description follows; do not mix it up with 的 or 地.
A light particle after a verb to say you have had an experience: 去过中国 "have been to China". The negative is 没去过. It differs from 了, which marks completion.
Let, make, ask someone to: 妈妈让我早点睡 "Mom told me to sleep early". 让我看看 "let me see". It is followed by a person and a verb.
What color do you like?: Mom told me to go to bed early.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Serve as, be: 当老师 "become a teacher". Also "when", in 当我到家时 "when I got home". Read dāng here. With the fourth tone, dàng, it means "treat as".
你喜欢什么颜色？: 当我到家时，天已经黑了。
你喜歡什麼顏色？: 當我到家時，天已經黑了。
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Dāng wǒ dào jiā shí, tiān yǐjīng hēi le.
What color do you like?: When I got home, it was already dark.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Wait until: 等到你来 "by the time you come". The main clause often has 就.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Děngdào nǐ lái, wǒmen jiù chīfàn.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Equal to: 二加三等于五 "two plus three equals five". 等于 also means "amounts to": 这等于没说.
Here 倒 is read dào, a word for contrast: 这件衣服倒不贵 "this shirt, in fact, isn't expensive". It also means "pour": 倒水. With the third tone it is dǎo, "fall over".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Zhè jiàn yīfu dào bù guì.
What color do you like?: This piece of clothing isn't expensive, actually.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Here 只 is read zhǐ, "only": 我只有一个哥哥 "I only have one older brother". It goes before the verb. As a measure word for animals it is zhī, written 隻 in traditional script, but this zhǐ stays 只.
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Wǒ zhǐ yǒu yī ge gēge.
What color do you like?: I only have one older brother.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Lean on, depend on: 靠自己 "depend on oneself". It also means "near": 靠窗 "by the window".
Nǐ xǐhuan shénme yánsè?: Tā kào zìjǐ xuéhuì le Hànyǔ.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Through, open, and "connect": 这条路不通 "this road is blocked". 想通 means "work something out".
Save: 省钱 "save money", 省时间 "save time". It is also "province", read shěng: 广东省.
What color do you like?: You can save money by taking the subway.

Color in general, as in 你喜欢什么颜色？ Alone,: Separate, part: 他们分开住 "they live apart".
